instruction: Write a DataStore script to save and load a player's Wins value.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local wins = 0
    if success and data then
        wins = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Wins"
    stat.Value = wins
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Wins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Make a script that an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

instruction: Write a script to create a trading system between players in Roblox
output:
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local tradeReq = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
tradeReq.Name = "TradeRequest"
tradeReq.Parent = RS
local tradeAcc = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
tradeAcc.Name = "TradeAccept"
tradeAcc.Parent = RS
local pending = {}

tradeReq.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(sender, targetName)
	local target = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
	if not target or sender == target then return end
	pending[sender.UserId] = {Sender=sender, Target=target}
	tradeReq:FireClient(target, sender.Name)
end)

tradeAcc.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, accepted)
	for uid, trade in pending do
		if trade.Target == player then
			if accepted then
				print("Trade accepted: "..trade.Sender.Name.." <-> "..trade.Target.Name)
			end
			pending[uid] = nil
			break
		end
	end
end)

instruction: Create a Luau script that will a smooth third-person camera that follows the player.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 8, 12)
local SMOOTHNESS = 0.2

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not rootPart then return end
        
        local targetPosition = rootPart.Position + OFFSET
        local currentCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition, rootPart.Position)
        
        camera.CFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, SMOOTHNESS)
    end)
end)

instruction: How do I create a save slot system in Roblox Luau?
output:
local DSS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MAX_SLOTS = 3
local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
remote.Name = "SaveSlotRemote"
remote.Parent = RS

remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, slot, data)
	if slot < 1 or slot > MAX_SLOTS then return false, "Invalid slot" end
	local store = DSS:GetDataStore("SaveSlot_"..slot)
	local key = "Player_"..player.UserId
	if action == "save" then
		local ok,err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync(key, {Data=data, Time=os.time()}) end)
		return ok, ok and "Saved!" or err
	elseif action == "load" then
		local ok,r = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync(key) end)
		return ok and r ~= nil, r or "No data"
	elseif action == "delete" then
		local ok,err = pcall(function() store:RemoveAsync(key) end)
		return ok, ok and "Deleted!" or err
	end
	return false, "Unknown action"
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local remoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameStateChange")

remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, data)
    if not player or not player:IsA("Player") then
        return
    end
    
    if typeof(data) ~= "table" then
        warn("Invalid data received from " .. player.Name)
        return
    end
    
    print(player.Name .. " triggered GameStateChange with data:", data)
    -- Handle the event here
end)

    end

local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function filterText(text, fromPlayer, toPlayer)
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        local textObject = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, fromPlayer.UserId)
        
        if toPlayer then
            return textObject:GetChatForUserAsync(toPlayer.UserId)
        else
            return textObject:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
        end
    end)
    
    if success then
        return result
    else
        return "***"
    end
end

instruction: What's the code to a simple cutscene camera that moves between waypoints.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local waypoints = {
    CFrame.new(0, 20, 50) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, 0),
    CFrame.new(30, 15, 30) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), math.rad(-30), 0),
    CFrame.new(0, 10, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), math.rad(180), 0),
}

local function playCutscene()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    camera.CFrame = waypoints[1]
    
    for i = 2, #waypoints do
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
        local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, tweenInfo, {
            CFrame = waypoints[i]
        })
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
    
    -- Return to player camera
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
end

playCutscene()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 9)
    end)
end)

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 200 dealing 50 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local speed = 200
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: What's the code to Implement an OOP class pattern in Luau for a game entity.
output:
-- ModuleScript: Entity
local Entity = {}
Entity.__index = Entity

export type EntityData = {
    name: string,
    health: number,
    maxHealth: number,
    damage: number,
    speed: number,
}

function Entity.new(data: EntityData)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Entity)
    self.name = data.name
    self.health = data.health or 100
    self.maxHealth = data.maxHealth or 100
    self.damage = data.damage or 10
    self.speed = data.speed or 16
    self.isAlive = true
    self.effects = {}
    return self
end

function Entity:takeDamage(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    
    self.health = math.max(0, self.health - amount)
    
    if self.health <= 0 then
        self.isAlive = false
        self:onDeath()
    end
end

function Entity:heal(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    self.health = math.min(self.maxHealth, self.health + amount)
end

function Entity:addEffect(effectName: string, duration: number)
    self.effects[effectName] = {
        startTime = os.clock(),
        duration = duration
    }
end

function Entity:hasEffect(effectName: string): boolean
    local effect = self.effects[effectName]
    if not effect then return false end
    
    if os.clock() - effect.startTime > effect.duration then
        self.effects[effectName] = nil
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

function Entity:onDeath()
    print(self.name .. " has been defeated!")
end

function Entity:getHealthPercentage(): number
    return self.health / self.maxHealth
end

return Entity

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 15s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 15

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("KillsLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Kills")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

instruction: Script for Demonstrate Luau table creation, manipulation, and iteration.
output:
-- Array-style table
local fruits = {"Apple", "Banana", "Cherry"}
table.insert(fruits, "Date")
table.remove(fruits, 2) -- Removes "Banana"
print(#fruits) -- Length: 3

-- Dictionary-style table
local player = {
    name = "Hero",
    health = 100,
    level = 1,
    inventory = {}
}

-- Accessing values
print(player.name)
print(player["health"])

-- Adding/modifying
player.score = 0
player.health = 80

-- Iteration
for index, value in ipairs(fruits) do
    print(index, value)
end

for key, value in pairs(player) do
    print(key, "=", value)
end

-- Table utility functions
local numbers = {5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2}
table.sort(numbers)
print(table.concat(numbers, ", ")) -- 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9

local found = table.find(fruits, "Apple")
print(found) -- 1 (index)

    maxPlayers = 10,
    roundTime = 60
})

instruction: Script for Filter text using TextService for safe display in a Roblox game.
output:
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function filterText(text, fromPlayer, toPlayer)
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        local textObject = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, fromPlayer.UserId)
        
        if toPlayer then
            return textObject:GetChatForUserAsync(toPlayer.UserId)
        else
            return textObject:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
        end
    end)
    
    if success then
        return result
    else
        return "***"
    end
end

-- Usage
local filtered = filterText("Hello world!", senderPlayer, receiverPlayer)
print(filtered)

output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local function castRay()
    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 50
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    if result then
        print("Hit: " .. result.Instance:GetFullName())
        print("Position: " .. tostring(result.Position))
        print("Normal: " .. tostring(result.Normal))
        print("Distance: " .. tostring(result.Distance))
        return result
    end
    
    return nil
end

instruction: Give me a script for a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not rootPart then return end
        
        local targetPosition = rootPart.Position + OFFSET
        local currentCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition, rootPart.Position)
        
        camera.CFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, SMOOTHNESS)
    end)
end)

instruction: Build a system that a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 15s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 15

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Create a Sword tool that deals 30 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

end

instruction: Can you write code to Show different debounce patterns used in Roblox development.
output:
-- Simple boolean debounce
local debounce = false

local function onTouch(hit)
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    -- Do something
    print("Touched!")
    
    task.wait(1)
    debounce = false
end

-- Per-player debounce
local playerDebounce = {}

local function onPlayerTouch(player)
    if playerDebounce[player.UserId] then return end
    playerDebounce[player.UserId] = true
    
    print(player.Name .. " activated!")
    
    task.delay(2, function()
        playerDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end)
end

-- Throttle pattern (limit calls per time window)
local function throttle(func, interval)
    local lastCall = 0
    return function(...)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCall >= interval then
            lastCall = now
            return func(...)
        end
    end
end

local throttledPrint = throttle(function(msg)
    print(msg)
end, 1)

-- Cooldown with visual feedback
local function createCooldown(duration)
    local isReady = true
    local remaining = 0
    
    return {
        use = function()
            if not isReady then return false end
            isReady = false
            remaining = duration
            
            task.spawn(function()
                while remaining > 0 do
                    remaining = remaining - task.wait()
                end
                remaining = 0
                isReady = true
            end)
            
            return true
        end,
        isReady = function() return isReady end,
        getRemaining = function() return remaining end
    }
end

instruction: Give me a script for an NPC that wanders randomly within a defined area.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local HOME_POSITION = rootPart.Position
local WAIT_TIME_MIN = 2
local WAIT_TIME_MAX = 6

local function getRandomPoint()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random() * WANDER_RADIUS
    
    return HOME_POSITION + Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )
end

local function wanderTo(position)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
    })
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, position)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then break end
        end
    end
end

-- Wander loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getRandomPoint()
    wanderTo(target)
    
    local waitTime = math.random(WAIT_TIME_MIN, WAIT_TIME_MAX)
    task.wait(waitTime)
end

end

local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 10
local speed = 150
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Can you write code to Show error handling patterns in Luau with pcall and xpcall.
output:
-- Basic pcall
local success, result = pcall(function()
    return 10 / 0
end)

if success then
    print("Result: " .. result)
else
    warn("Error: " .. tostring(result))
end

-- pcall with arguments
local success, data = pcall(function()
    local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
    local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
    return store:GetAsync("Player_123")
end)

-- xpcall with custom error handler
local success, result = xpcall(
    function()
        error("Something went wrong!")
    end,
    function(err)
        warn("Caught error: " .. err)
        warn(debug.traceback())
        return "Error handled"
    end
)

-- Retry pattern
local function withRetry(func, maxAttempts, delay)
    for attempt = 1, maxAttempts do
        local success, result = pcall(func)
        if success then
            return result
        end
        
        if attempt < maxAttempts then
            warn("Attempt " .. attempt .. " failed, retrying...")
            task.wait(delay)
        else
            warn("All " .. maxAttempts .. " attempts failed")
            return nil
        end
    end
end

-- Custom error types
local function validateInput(value)
    if typeof(value) ~= "number" then
        error({
            code = "INVALID_TYPE",
            message = "Expected number, got " .. typeof(value)
        })
    end
    if value < 0 then
        error({
            code = "OUT_OF_RANGE",
            message = "Value must be non-negative"
        })
    end
    return value
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local remoteFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
remoteFunction.Name = "GetPlayerData"
remoteFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

remoteFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
    -- Validate the player
    if not player or not player:IsA("Player") then
        return nil
    end
    
    -- Return data to the client
    return {
        success = true,
        data = "Response from GetPlayerData",

output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function getMouseRaycast()
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local unitRay = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(unitRay.Origin, unitRay.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
    
    return result
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        local result = getMouseRaycast()
        if result then
            print("Clicked on: " .. result.Instance.Name)
        end
    end
end)

output:
-- Basic pcall
local success, result = pcall(function()
    return 10 / 0
end)

if success then
    print("Result: " .. result)
else
    warn("Error: " .. tostring(result))
end

-- pcall with arguments
local success, data = pcall(function()
    local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
    local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
    return store:GetAsync("Player_123")
end)

-- xpcall with custom error handler
local success, result = xpcall(
    function()
        error("Something went wrong!")
    end,
    function(err)
        warn("Caught error: " .. err)
        warn(debug.traceback())
        return "Error handled"
    end
)

-- Retry pattern
local function withRetry(func, maxAttempts, delay)
    for attempt = 1, maxAttempts do
        local success, result = pcall(func)
        if success then
            return result
        end
        
        if attempt < maxAttempts then
            warn("Attempt " .. attempt .. " failed, retrying...")
            task.wait(delay)
        else
            warn("All " .. maxAttempts .. " attempts failed")
            return nil
        end
    end
end

-- Custom error types
local function validateInput(value)
    if typeof(value) ~= "number" then
        error({
            code = "INVALID_TYPE",
            message = "Expected number, got " .. typeof(value)
        })
    end
    if value < 0 then
        error({
            code = "OUT_OF_RANGE",
            message = "Value must be non-negative"
        })
    end
    return value
end

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to a simple ragdoll system that activates when the player dies.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function enableRagdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
    
    for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            
            a0.CFrame = joint.C0
            a1.CFrame = joint.C1
            a0.Parent = joint.Part0
            a1.Parent = joint.Part1
            
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.Parent = joint.Parent
            
            joint.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            enableRagdoll(character)
        end)
    end)
end)

instruction: I need to Implement an OOP class pattern in Luau for a game entity.
output:
-- ModuleScript: Entity
local Entity = {}
Entity.__index = Entity

export type EntityData = {
    name: string,
    health: number,
    maxHealth: number,
    damage: number,
    speed: number,
}

function Entity.new(data: EntityData)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Entity)
    self.name = data.name
    self.health = data.health or 100
    self.maxHealth = data.maxHealth or 100
    self.damage = data.damage or 10
    self.speed = data.speed or 16
    self.isAlive = true
    self.effects = {}
    return self
end

function Entity:takeDamage(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    
    self.health = math.max(0, self.health - amount)
    
    if self.health <= 0 then
        self.isAlive = false
        self:onDeath()
    end
end

function Entity:heal(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    self.health = math.min(self.maxHealth, self.health + amount)
end

function Entity:addEffect(effectName: string, duration: number)
    self.effects[effectName] = {
        startTime = os.clock(),
        duration = duration
    }
end

function Entity:hasEffect(effectName: string): boolean
    local effect = self.effects[effectName]
    if not effect then return false end
    
    if os.clock() - effect.startTime > effect.duration then
        self.effects[effectName] = nil
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

function Entity:onDeath()
    print(self.name .. " has been defeated!")
end

function Entity:getHealthPercentage(): number
    return self.health / self.maxHealth
end

return Entity

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 8, 12)
local SMOOTHNESS = 0.2

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not rootPart then return end
        
        local targetPosition = rootPart.Position + OFFSET
        local currentCFrame = camera.CFrame
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition, rootPart.Position)
        
        camera.CFrame = currentCFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, SMOOTHNESS)
    end)
end)

instruction: Code a script that an NPC that pathfinds to the nearest player.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FOLLOW_RANGE = 100
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.5

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDist = FOLLOW_RANGE
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest = character
                    nearestDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

local function moveTo(targetPosition)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
    })
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Main AI loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if target then
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            moveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
end

instruction: Show me how to an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

instruction: Write a Roblox script to a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 10s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 10

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Code a script that make a kill/death tracking system.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function setupLeaderstats(player)
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local kills = Instance.new("IntValue")
    kills.Name = "Kills"
    kills.Value = 0
    kills.Parent = leaderstats
    
    local deaths = Instance.new("IntValue")
    deaths.Name = "Deaths"
    deaths.Value = 0
    deaths.Parent = leaderstats
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        -- Increment deaths
        player.leaderstats.Deaths.Value = player.leaderstats.Deaths.Value + 1
        
        -- Find the killer using the damage tag
        local creator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
        if creator and creator.Value then
            local killer = creator.Value
            if killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player then
                killer.leaderstats.Kills.Value = killer.leaderstats.Kills.Value + 1
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    setupLeaderstats(player)
    
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    end)
end)

-- To tag a kill (call this when a weapon damages someone):
local function tagHumanoid(humanoid, attacker)
    local creator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
    if not creator then
        creator = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
        creator.Name = "creator"
        creator.Parent = humanoid
    end
    creator.Value = attacker
    
    -- Remove tag after 3 seconds
    task.delay(3, function()
        if creator and creator.Parent then
            creator:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Create an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

instruction: Code a script that an enemy/NPC spawning system that spawns enemies at random spawn points on a timer.
output:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

instruction: What is the difference between a Script and a LocalScript in Roblox?
output:
Scripts and LocalScripts serve different purposes in Roblox:

**Script (Server Script):**
- Runs on the server
- Has access to server-side services (DataStoreService, ServerStorage, etc.)
- Can modify the game for all players
- Cannot access client-only services (UserInputService, camera, etc.)
- Placed in ServerScriptService, Workspace, or parts

**LocalScript (Client Script):**
- Runs on each player's client individually
- Has access to client services (UserInputService, camera, PlayerGui, etc.)
- Changes are only visible to that specific player
- Cannot directly access ServerStorage or server-side DataStores
- Placed in StarterPlayerScripts, StarterCharacterScripts, or PlayerGui

Communication between them uses RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions.

local function castRay()
    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 200

    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}

    end

end

instruction: Create a Luau script that will an NPC that pathfinds to the nearest player.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FOLLOW_RANGE = 100
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.5

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDist = FOLLOW_RANGE
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest = character
                    nearestDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

local function moveTo(targetPosition)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
    })
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Main AI loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if target then
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            moveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
end

    local character = player.Character

    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function isOnGround(character)
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return false end
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    
    local origin = rootPart.Position
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    return result ~= nil
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local grounded = isOnGround(character)
        -- Use grounded state for game logic
    end)
end)

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 90s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 90
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local HOME_POSITION = rootPart.Position
local WAIT_TIME_MIN = 2
local WAIT_TIME_MAX = 6

local function getRandomPoint()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random() * WANDER_RADIUS
    
    return HOME_POSITION + Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )
end

local function wanderTo(position)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
    })
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, position)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then break end
        end
    end
end

-- Wander loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getRandomPoint()
    wanderTo(target)
    
    local waitTime = math.random(WAIT_TIME_MIN, WAIT_TIME_MAX)
    task.wait(waitTime)
end

instruction: Give me a script for an enemy/NPC spawning system that spawns enemies at random spawn points on a timer.
output:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

instruction: Script for an enemy/NPC spawning system that spawns enemies at random spawn points on a timer.
output:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local speed = 150
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

    debounce = false
end

-- Per-player debounce
local playerDebounce = {}

local function onPlayerTouch(player)
    if playerDebounce[player.UserId] then return end
    playerDebounce[player.UserId] = true
    
    print(player.Name .. " activated!")
    
    task.delay(2, function()
        playerDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end)
end

-- Throttle pattern (limit calls per time window)
local function throttle(func, interval)
    local lastCall = 0
    return function(...)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCall >= interval then
            lastCall = now
            return func(...)
        end
    end
end

local throttledPrint = throttle(function(msg)
    print(msg)
end, 1)

-- Cooldown with visual feedback
local function createCooldown(duration)
    local isReady = true
    local remaining = 0
    
    return {
        use = function()
            if not isReady then return false end
            isReady = false
            remaining = duration
            
            task.spawn(function()
                while remaining > 0 do
                    remaining = remaining - task.wait()
                end
                remaining = 0
                isReady = true
            end)
            
            return true
        end,
        isReady = function() return isReady end,
        getRemaining = function() return remaining end
    }
end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("LevelLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Level")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 90s rounds and 20s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 90
local INTERMISSION = 20

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 8)
    end)
end)

instruction: Write a Roblox script to Use DataStore UpdateAsync to safely increment a player's coins.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins")

local function addCoins(userId, amount)
    local success, newValue = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(oldValue)
            local currentCoins = oldValue or 0
            return currentCoins + amount
        end)
    end)
    
    if success then
        print("Coins updated to: " .. newValue)
        return newValue
    else
        warn("Failed to update coins for user " .. userId)
        return nil
    end
end

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to a DataStore system that saves a full player profile table with multiple stats and inventory.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerProfiles")

local DEFAULT_DATA = {
    coins = 0,
    gems = 0,
    level = 1,
    experience = 0,
    inventory = {},
    settings = {
        musicEnabled = true,
        sfxEnabled = true,
    },
    stats = {
        wins = 0,
        losses = 0,
        totalPlayTime = 0,
    }
}

local playerData = {}

local function deepCopy(original)
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(original) do
        if typeof(value) == "table" then
            copy[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            copy[key] = value
        end
    end
    return copy
end

local function loadData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    if success and data then
        playerData[player.UserId] = data
    else
        playerData[player.UserId] = deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
    end
    
    return playerData[player.UserId]
end

local function saveData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local data = playerData[player.UserId]
    
    if data then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, data)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save data for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    loadData(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    saveData(player)
    playerData[player.UserId] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        saveData(player)
    end
end)

instruction: Create a Gun tool that deals 50 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Give me a script for an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 200 dealing 20 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 20
local speed = 200
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Help me Show different debounce patterns used in Roblox development.
output:
-- Simple boolean debounce
local debounce = false

local function onTouch(hit)
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    -- Do something
    print("Touched!")
    
    task.wait(1)
    debounce = false
end

-- Per-player debounce
local playerDebounce = {}

local function onPlayerTouch(player)
    if playerDebounce[player.UserId] then return end
    playerDebounce[player.UserId] = true
    
    print(player.Name .. " activated!")
    
    task.delay(2, function()
        playerDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end)
end

-- Throttle pattern (limit calls per time window)
local function throttle(func, interval)
    local lastCall = 0
    return function(...)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCall >= interval then
            lastCall = now
            return func(...)
        end
    end
end

local throttledPrint = throttle(function(msg)
    print(msg)
end, 1)

-- Cooldown with visual feedback
local function createCooldown(duration)
    local isReady = true
    local remaining = 0
    
    return {
        use = function()
            if not isReady then return false end
            isReady = false
            remaining = duration
            
            task.spawn(function()
                while remaining > 0 do
                    remaining = remaining - task.wait()
                end
                remaining = 0
                isReady = true
            end)
            
            return true
        end,
        isReady = function() return isReady end,
        getRemaining = function() return remaining end
    }
end

instruction: Implement a way to a custom chat command that handles '/give' to give items to players.
output:
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local textChatCommands = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChatCommands", 5)
if not textChatCommands then
    textChatCommands = Instance.new("Folder")
    textChatCommands.Name = "TextChatCommands"
    textChatCommands.Parent = TextChatService
end

local giveCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
giveCommand.Name = "GiveCommand"
giveCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/give"
giveCommand.SecondaryAlias = "/g"
giveCommand.Parent = textChatCommands

giveCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
    if not player then return end
    
    local args = string.split(message, " ")
    -- /give PlayerName ItemName
    if #args >= 3 then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local itemName = args[3]
        
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(p.Name):find(string.lower(targetName)) then
                targetPlayer = p
                break
            end
        end
        
        if targetPlayer then
            print(player.Name .. " gave " .. itemName .. " to " .. targetPlayer.Name)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Write a Roblox script to Show error handling patterns in Luau with pcall and xpcall.
output:
-- Basic pcall
local success, result = pcall(function()
    return 10 / 0
end)

if success then
    print("Result: " .. result)
else
    warn("Error: " .. tostring(result))
end

-- pcall with arguments
local success, data = pcall(function()
    local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
    local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
    return store:GetAsync("Player_123")
end)

-- xpcall with custom error handler
local success, result = xpcall(
    function()
        error("Something went wrong!")
    end,
    function(err)
        warn("Caught error: " .. err)
        warn(debug.traceback())
        return "Error handled"
    end
)

-- Retry pattern
local function withRetry(func, maxAttempts, delay)
    for attempt = 1, maxAttempts do
        local success, result = pcall(func)
        if success then
            return result
        end
        
        if attempt < maxAttempts then
            warn("Attempt " .. attempt .. " failed, retrying...")
            task.wait(delay)
        else
            warn("All " .. maxAttempts .. " attempts failed")
            return nil
        end
    end
end

-- Custom error types
local function validateInput(value)
    if typeof(value) ~= "number" then
        error({
            code = "INVALID_TYPE",
            message = "Expected number, got " .. typeof(value)
        })
    end
    if value < 0 then
        error({
            code = "OUT_OF_RANGE",
            message = "Value must be non-negative"
        })
    end
    return value
end

instruction: Build a system that a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 100 dealing 30 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local speed = 100
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)
