instruction: Show different ways to define and use functions in Luau.
output:
-- Basic function
local function greet(name)
    return "Hello, " .. name .. "!"
end

-- Function with multiple returns
local function divide(a, b)
    if b == 0 then
        return nil, "Cannot divide by zero"
    end
    return a / b, nil
end

local result, err = divide(10, 3)

-- Variadic function
local function sum(...)
    local total = 0
    for _, v in ipairs({...}) do
        total = total + v
    end
    return total
end
print(sum(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)) -- 15

-- Type-annotated function (Luau)
local function calculateDamage(base: number, multiplier: number): number
    return base * multiplier
end

-- Closure
local function createCounter()
    local count = 0
    return function()
        count = count + 1
        return count
    end
end

local counter = createCounter()
print(counter()) -- 1
print(counter()) -- 2

-- Method syntax
local Character = {}
Character.__index = Character

function Character.new(name, health)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Character)
    self.name = name
    self.health = health
    return self
end

function Character:takeDamage(amount)
    self.health = math.max(0, self.health - amount)
end

local hero = Character.new("Hero", 100)
hero:takeDamage(25)

instruction: Implement a way to Use CollectionService to tag and manage groups of objects.
output:
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- Tag objects
local function setupLava(part)
    part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local character = hit.Parent
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:TakeDamage(10)
        end
    end)
end

-- Apply behavior to all tagged objects
for _, part in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Lava")) do
    setupLava(part)
end

-- Handle objects added at runtime
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Lava"):Connect(function(part)
    setupLava(part)
end)

CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("Lava"):Connect(function(part)
    print(part.Name .. " is no longer lava")
end)

-- Tag management
local function addTag(instance, tag)
    CollectionService:AddTag(instance, tag)
end

local function removeTag(instance, tag)
    CollectionService:RemoveTag(instance, tag)
end

local function hasTag(instance, tag)
    return CollectionService:HasTag(instance, tag)
end

-- Example: Collectible coins
for _, coin in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Coin")) do
    coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
        if player then
            local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Coins") then
                ls.Coins.Value = ls.Coins.Value + 1
            end
            coin:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Build a system that a simple cutscene camera that moves between waypoints.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local waypoints = {
    CFrame.new(0, 20, 50) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, 0),
    CFrame.new(30, 15, 30) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), math.rad(-30), 0),
    CFrame.new(0, 10, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), math.rad(180), 0),
}

local function playCutscene()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    camera.CFrame = waypoints[1]
    
    for i = 2, #waypoints do
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
        local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, tweenInfo, {
            CFrame = waypoints[i]
        })
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
    
    -- Return to player camera
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
end

playCutscene()

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

gui.DisplayOrder = 10
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

layout.Parent = container

local function notify(title, msg, dur)
	dur = dur or 4
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,60)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.Parent = container
	Instance.new("UICorner",f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,1,0)
	t.Position = UDim2.new(0,5,0,0)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Text = title..": "..msg
	t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.TextTransparency = 1
	t.Parent = f
	local fadeIn = TweenInfo.new(0.3)
	TweenService:Create(f,fadeIn,{BackgroundTransparency=0.1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(t,fadeIn,{TextTransparency=0}):Play()
	task.delay(dur, function()
		local fadeOut = TweenInfo.new(0.5)
		TweenService:Create(f,fadeOut,{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
		local tw = TweenService:Create(t,fadeOut,{TextTransparency=1})
		tw:Play()
		tw.Completed:Wait()
		f:Destroy()
	end)
end

return notify

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("ScoreLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

instruction: Write a DataStore script to save and load a player's Coins value.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local coins = 0
    if success and data then
        coins = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Coins"
    stat.Value = coins
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

        TeleportService:Teleport(PLACE_ID, player)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Teleport failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        -- Retry after delay
        task.wait(2)
        pcall(function()
            TeleportService:Teleport(PLACE_ID, player)
        end)
    end
end

instruction: Script for an NPC that pathfinds to the nearest player.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FOLLOW_RANGE = 100
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.5

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDist = FOLLOW_RANGE
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest = character
                    nearestDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

local function moveTo(targetPosition)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
    })
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Main AI loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if target then
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            moveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local wins = 0
    if success and data then
        wins = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Wins"
    stat.Value = wins
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Wins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

-- Array-style table
local fruits = {"Apple", "Banana", "Cherry"}

-- Dictionary-style table
local player = {
    name = "Hero",
    health = 100,
    level = 1,
    inventory = {}
}

-- Accessing values
print(player.name)
print(player["health"])

-- Adding/modifying
player.score = 0
player.health = 80

-- Iteration
for index, value in ipairs(fruits) do
    print(index, value)
end

for key, value in pairs(player) do
    print(key, "=", value)
end

-- Table utility functions
local numbers = {5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2}
table.sort(numbers)
print(table.concat(numbers, ", ")) -- 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9

local found = table.find(fruits, "Apple")

instruction: How do I create an object pooling system in Roblox Luau?
output:
local Pool = {}
Pool.__index = Pool

function Pool.new(createFn, size)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pool)
	self._available = {}
	self._inUse = {}
	self._create = createFn
	for i=1,(size or 10) do
		local o = createFn()
		o.Parent = nil
		table.insert(self._available, o)
	end
	return self
end

function Pool:Get()
	local o = table.remove(self._available) or self._create()
	self._inUse[o] = true
	return o
end

function Pool:Return(o)
	if self._inUse[o] then
		self._inUse[o] = nil
		o.Parent = nil
		table.insert(self._available, o)
	end
end

return Pool

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 90s rounds and 15s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 90
local INTERMISSION = 15

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

    local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    
    if humanoid and player and not debounce[player.UserId] then
        debounce[player.UserId] = true
        
        local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Coins") then
                ls.Coins.Value = ls.Coins.Value + 10
            end
        
        task.wait(1)
        debounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end
end)

instruction: Give the player a ForceField that lasts 14 seconds.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 14)
    end)
end)

instruction: Script for prevent exploiters from cheating with RemoteEvents.
output:
-- Never trust the client! Always validate on the server.

-- BAD: Trusting client data
remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, coins)
    player.leaderstats.Coins.Value = coins -- Exploiter can send any value!
end)

-- GOOD: Server-side validation
remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
    -- Validate the action is legitimate
    if action ~= "collectCoin" then return end
    
    -- Server determines the reward, not the client
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end
    
    -- Check if player is actually near a coin
    local nearestCoin = nil
    for _, coin in pairs(workspace.Coins:GetChildren()) do
        if (coin.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude < 10 then
            nearestCoin = coin
            break
        end
    end
    
    if nearestCoin then
        nearestCoin:Destroy()
        player.leaderstats.Coins.Value = player.leaderstats.Coins.Value + 1
    end
end)

-- Also implement rate limiting
local lastAction = {}
remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lastAction[player.UserId] and now - lastAction[player.UserId] < 0.1 then
        return -- Too fast, likely exploiting
    end
    lastAction[player.UserId] = now
    
    -- Process normally
end)

instruction: How do I create an elevator system in Roblox Luau?
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local platform = script.Parent
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Call Elevator"
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 15
prompt.Parent = platform

local floors = {{Name="Ground",Y=5},{Name="Floor 1",Y=20},{Name="Floor 2",Y=35},{Name="Floor 3",Y=50}}
local current = 1
local moving = false

local function goTo(i)
	if moving or i<1 or i>#floors then return end
	moving = true
	local tween = TweenService:Create(platform, TweenInfo.new(2,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Position=Vector3.new(platform.Position.X,floors[i].Y,platform.Position.Z)})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()
	current = i
	moving = false
	prompt.ActionText = floors[current].Name
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
	goTo(current % #floors + 1)
end)
prompt.ActionText = floors[current].Name

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local experience = 0
    if success and data then
        experience = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Experience"
    stat.Value = experience
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Experience")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Experience for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Experience")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 10
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Implement a way to an enemy/NPC spawning system that spawns enemies at random spawn points on a timer.
output:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

instruction: Script for an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

instruction: Give me a script for a DataStore system that saves a full player profile table with multiple stats and inventory.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerProfiles")

local DEFAULT_DATA = {
    coins = 0,
    gems = 0,
    level = 1,
    experience = 0,
    inventory = {},
    settings = {
        musicEnabled = true,
        sfxEnabled = true,
    },
    stats = {
        wins = 0,
        losses = 0,
        totalPlayTime = 0,
    }
}

local playerData = {}

local function deepCopy(original)
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(original) do
        if typeof(value) == "table" then
            copy[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            copy[key] = value
        end
    end
    return copy
end

local function loadData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    if success and data then
        playerData[player.UserId] = data
    else
        playerData[player.UserId] = deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
    end
    
    return playerData[player.UserId]
end

local function saveData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local data = playerData[player.UserId]
    
    if data then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, data)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save data for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    loadData(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    saveData(player)
    playerData[player.UserId] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        saveData(player)
    end
end)

instruction: Create a Luau script that will a simple ragdoll system that activates when the player dies.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function enableRagdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
    
    for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            
            a0.CFrame = joint.C0
            a1.CFrame = joint.C1
            a0.Parent = joint.Part0
            a1.Parent = joint.Part1
            
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.Parent = joint.Parent
            
            joint.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            enableRagdoll(character)
        end)
    end)
end)

local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local textChatCommands = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChatCommands", 5)
if not textChatCommands then
    textChatCommands = Instance.new("Folder")
    textChatCommands.Name = "TextChatCommands"
    textChatCommands.Parent = TextChatService
end

local giveCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
giveCommand.Name = "GiveCommand"
giveCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/give"
giveCommand.SecondaryAlias = "/g"
giveCommand.Parent = textChatCommands

giveCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
    if not player then return end
    
    local args = string.split(message, " ")
    -- /give PlayerName ItemName
    if #args >= 3 then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local itemName = args[3]
        
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(p.Name):find(string.lower(targetName)) then
                targetPlayer = p
                break
            end
        end
        
        if targetPlayer then
            print(player.Name .. " gave " .. itemName .. " to " .. targetPlayer.Name)
        end
    end
end)

local function showDamage(pos, dmg, crit)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.new(4,0,2,0)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-10,10)/10, 0, math.random(-10,10)/10)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bb.MaxDistance = 50
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = tostring(math.floor(dmg))..(crit and "!" or "")
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = crit and Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50) or Color3.new(1,1,1)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	label.Parent = bb
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
	anchor.Position = pos
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.Parent = workspace
	bb.Parent = anchor
	TweenService:Create(anchor, TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position=pos+Vector3.new(0,4,0)}):Play()
	local fade = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.In,0,false,0.5), {TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1})
	fade:Play()
	fade.Completed:Connect(function() anchor:Destroy() end)
end

return showDamage

instruction: Demonstrate Luau control flow: if/elseif/else, loops, and conditionals.
output:
-- If/elseif/else
local health = 75
if health > 80 then
    print("Healthy")
elseif health > 40 then
    print("Wounded")
elseif health > 0 then
    print("Critical")
else
    print("Dead")
end

-- Ternary-like pattern (Luau)
local status = if health > 50 then "Alive" else "Dying"

-- For loop (numeric)
for i = 1, 10 do
    print(i)
end

-- For loop with step
for i = 10, 1, -1 do
    print(i) -- Countdown
end

-- While loop
local count = 0
while count < 5 do
    count = count + 1
    print(count)
end

-- Repeat/until
repeat
    count = count - 1
until count <= 0

-- Continue (Luau feature)
for i = 1, 10 do
    if i % 2 == 0 then
        continue -- Skip even numbers
    end
    print(i) -- Only odd numbers
end

-- Break
for i = 1, 100 do
    if i > 10 then
        break
    end
    print(i)
end

            if humanoid then

    end

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 60s rounds and 30s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 60
local INTERMISSION = 30

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Build a system that a camera shake effect for explosions or impacts.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local shakeData = {
    intensity = 0,
    duration = 0,
    elapsed = 0,
    active = false
}

local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    shakeData.intensity = intensity
    shakeData.duration = duration
    shakeData.elapsed = 0
    shakeData.active = true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not shakeData.active then return end
    
    shakeData.elapsed = shakeData.elapsed + dt
    
    if shakeData.elapsed >= shakeData.duration then
        shakeData.active = false
        return
    end
    
    local progress = shakeData.elapsed / shakeData.duration
    local currentIntensity = shakeData.intensity * (1 - progress)
    
    local offsetX = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetY = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetZ = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    
    camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsetX, offsetY, offsetZ)
end)

-- Usage: shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
-- shakeCamera(2, 0.5) -- Strong, short shake
-- shakeCamera(0.5, 2) -- Mild, long shake

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

    local character = hit.Parent
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    
    if humanoid and player and not debounce[player.UserId] then
        debounce[player.UserId] = true
        
        local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
            end
        
        task.wait(1)
        debounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end
end)

instruction: How do I an NPC that wanders randomly within a defined area.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local HOME_POSITION = rootPart.Position
local WAIT_TIME_MIN = 2
local WAIT_TIME_MAX = 6

local function getRandomPoint()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random() * WANDER_RADIUS
    
    return HOME_POSITION + Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )
end

local function wanderTo(position)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
    })
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, position)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then break end
        end
    end
end

-- Wander loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getRandomPoint()
    wanderTo(target)
    
    local waitTime = math.random(WAIT_TIME_MIN, WAIT_TIME_MAX)
    task.wait(waitTime)
end

output:
local function createHealthBar(character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local head = character:WaitForChild("Head")
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.new(4,0,0.5,0)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
	bb.Parent = head
	local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
	bg.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
	bg.Parent = bb
	Instance.new("UICorner", bg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4)
	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
	bar.Parent = bg
	Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,4)
	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(hp)
		local pct = hp / humanoid.MaxHealth
		bar.Size = UDim2.new(pct,0,1,0)
		bar.BackgroundColor3 = pct > 0.5 and Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0) or pct > 0.25 and Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0) or Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
	end)
end

game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
	p.CharacterAdded:Connect(createHealthBar)
end)

instruction: Give me a script for a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 150 dealing 10 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 10
local speed = 150
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

local tool = script.Parent

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 300s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 300
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Make a script that a simple cutscene camera that moves between waypoints.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local waypoints = {
    CFrame.new(0, 20, 50) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, 0),
    CFrame.new(30, 15, 30) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-15), math.rad(-30), 0),
    CFrame.new(0, 10, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), math.rad(180), 0),
}

local function playCutscene()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    camera.CFrame = waypoints[1]
    
    for i = 2, #waypoints do
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
        local tween = TweenService:Create(camera, tweenInfo, {
            CFrame = waypoints[i]
        })
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
    
    -- Return to player camera
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
end

playCutscene()

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 120s rounds and 30s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 120
local INTERMISSION = 30

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to a camera shake effect for explosions or impacts.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local shakeData = {
    intensity = 0,
    duration = 0,
    elapsed = 0,
    active = false
}

local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    shakeData.intensity = intensity
    shakeData.duration = duration
    shakeData.elapsed = 0
    shakeData.active = true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not shakeData.active then return end
    
    shakeData.elapsed = shakeData.elapsed + dt
    
    if shakeData.elapsed >= shakeData.duration then
        shakeData.active = false
        return
    end
    
    local progress = shakeData.elapsed / shakeData.duration
    local currentIntensity = shakeData.intensity * (1 - progress)
    
    local offsetX = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetY = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetZ = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    
    camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsetX, offsetY, offsetZ)
end)

-- Usage: shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
-- shakeCamera(2, 0.5) -- Strong, short shake
-- shakeCamera(0.5, 2) -- Mild, long shake

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local door = script.Parent
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open Door"

local isOpen = false
local isTweening = false

local closedCFrame = door.CFrame
local openCFrame = closedCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0) * CFrame.new(-door.Size.X / 2, 0, door.Size.X / 2)

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    if isTweening then return end
    isTweening = true
    
    local targetCFrame
    if isOpen then
        targetCFrame = closedCFrame
        prompt.ActionText = "Open Door"
    else
        targetCFrame = openCFrame
        prompt.ActionText = "Close Door"
    end
    
    local tween = TweenService:Create(door, tweenInfo, {
        CFrame = targetCFrame
    })
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()
    
    isOpen = not isOpen
    isTweening = false
end)

instruction: Create a Staff tool that deals 20 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 20
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

    debounce = true

    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox

        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then

    end

    task.wait(cooldown)

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 30s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 30

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Write a DataStore script to save and load a player's Level value.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local level = 1
    if success and data then
        level = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Level"
    stat.Value = level
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Level")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Level for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Level")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 100 dealing 50 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local speed = 100
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: How do I use BindableEvents for server-to-server script communication?
output:
-- BindableEvents allow communication between server scripts
-- (Unlike RemoteEvents which are client-server)

-- Create or reference a BindableEvent
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
bindable.Name = "GameEvent"
bindable.Parent = ServerStorage

-- Script A: Fire the event
local gameEvent = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("GameEvent")
gameEvent:Fire("roundStart", {map = "Desert", time = 60})

-- Script B: Listen for the event
local gameEvent = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("GameEvent")
gameEvent.Event:Connect(function(eventType, data)
    if eventType == "roundStart" then
        print("Starting round on " .. data.map)
    end
end)

-- BindableFunctions for request/response between scripts
local bindableFunc = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
bindableFunc.Name = "GetData"
bindableFunc.Parent = ServerStorage

-- Script A: Handle invocations
bindableFunc.OnInvoke = function(key)
    if key == "playerCount" then
        return #game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
    end
    return nil
end

-- Script B: Invoke and get result
local count = bindableFunc:Invoke("playerCount")
print("Players online: " .. count)

output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 3)
    end)
end)

-- ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage
local InventoryModule = {}

local inventories = {}

function InventoryModule.create(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = {
        items = {},
        maxSlots = 20
    }
end

function InventoryModule.addItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false, "No inventory" end
    
    if inv.items[itemName] then
        inv.items[itemName] = inv.items[itemName] + (quantity or 1)
    else
        -- Check slot limit
        local slotCount = 0
        for _ in pairs(inv.items) do
            slotCount = slotCount + 1
        end
        
        if slotCount >= inv.maxSlots then
            return false, "Inventory full"
        end
        
        inv.items[itemName] = quantity or 1
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.removeItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    
    local current = inv.items[itemName]
    if not current then return false end
    
    local removeAmount = quantity or 1
    if current <= removeAmount then
        inv.items[itemName] = nil
    else
        inv.items[itemName] = current - removeAmount
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.getItems(player)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return {} end
    return inv.items
end

function InventoryModule.hasItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    return (inv.items[itemName] or 0) >= (quantity or 1)
end

function InventoryModule.destroy(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = nil
end

return InventoryModule

instruction: Write a DataStore system that saves a full player profile table with multiple stats and inventory.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerProfiles")

local DEFAULT_DATA = {
    coins = 0,
    gems = 0,
    level = 1,
    experience = 0,
    inventory = {},
    settings = {
        musicEnabled = true,
        sfxEnabled = true,
    },
    stats = {
        wins = 0,
        losses = 0,
        totalPlayTime = 0,
    }
}

local playerData = {}

local function deepCopy(original)
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(original) do
        if typeof(value) == "table" then
            copy[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            copy[key] = value
        end
    end
    return copy
end

local function loadData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    if success and data then
        playerData[player.UserId] = data
    else
        playerData[player.UserId] = deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
    end
    
    return playerData[player.UserId]
end

local function saveData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local data = playerData[player.UserId]
    
    if data then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, data)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save data for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    loadData(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    saveData(player)
    playerData[player.UserId] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        saveData(player)
    end
end)

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 120s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 120
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: I need to a global leaderboard using OrderedDataStore for top players by Kills.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("KillsLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Kills")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

instruction: Create an NPC that pathfinds to the nearest player.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FOLLOW_RANGE = 100
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.5

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDist = FOLLOW_RANGE
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest = character
                    nearestDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

local function moveTo(targetPosition)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
    })
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Main AI loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if target then
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            moveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function isOnGround(character)
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return false end
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    
    local origin = rootPart.Position
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    return result ~= nil
end

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local grounded = isOnGround(character)
        -- Use grounded state for game logic
    end)
end)

instruction: Implement create a leveling / experience system in Roblox
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local lvlUp = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
lvlUp.Name = "LevelUp"
lvlUp.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function xpNeeded(lvl) return math.floor(100 * lvl^1.5) end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
	local ls = Instance.new("Folder")
	ls.Name = "leaderstats"
	ls.Parent = p
	local lv = Instance.new("IntValue")
	lv.Name = "Level"
	lv.Value = 1
	lv.Parent = ls
	local xp = Instance.new("IntValue")
	xp.Name = "XP"
	xp.Value = 0
	xp.Parent = ls
end)

local function giveXP(player, amount)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not ls then return end
	local xp,lv = ls.XP, ls.Level
	xp.Value += amount
	while xp.Value >= xpNeeded(lv.Value) do
		xp.Value -= xpNeeded(lv.Value)
		lv.Value += 1
		lvlUp:FireClient(player, lv.Value)
	end
end

instruction: Create a Sword tool that deals 50 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 150 dealing 20 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 20
local speed = 150
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create a Luau script that will Cast a ray from the player's camera in the look direction for 500 studs.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local function castRay()
    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 500
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    if result then
        print("Hit: " .. result.Instance:GetFullName())
        print("Position: " .. tostring(result.Position))
        print("Normal: " .. tostring(result.Normal))
        print("Distance: " .. tostring(result.Distance))
        return result
    end
    
    return nil
end

instruction: Give the player a ForceField that lasts 7 seconds.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 7)
    end)
end)

    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    
    if humanoid and player and not debounce[player.UserId] then
        debounce[player.UserId] = true
        
        local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Coins") then

            end
        
        task.wait(1)
        debounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end
end)

output:
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local textChatCommands = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChatCommands", 5)
if not textChatCommands then
    textChatCommands = Instance.new("Folder")
    textChatCommands.Name = "TextChatCommands"
    textChatCommands.Parent = TextChatService
end

local giveCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
giveCommand.Name = "GiveCommand"
giveCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/give"
giveCommand.SecondaryAlias = "/g"
giveCommand.Parent = textChatCommands

giveCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
    if not player then return end
    
    local args = string.split(message, " ")
    -- /give PlayerName ItemName
    if #args >= 3 then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local itemName = args[3]
        
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(p.Name):find(string.lower(targetName)) then
                targetPlayer = p
                break
            end
        end
        
        if targetPlayer then
            print(player.Name .. " gave " .. itemName .. " to " .. targetPlayer.Name)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Can you write code to a map voting system where players can vote for one of three maps.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local maps = {"Desert", "Forest", "City"}
local votes = {}
local playerVotes = {}

local voteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
voteEvent.Name = "VoteEvent"
voteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function resetVotes()
    votes = {}
    for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
        votes[mapName] = 0
    end
    playerVotes = {}
end

local function getWinningMap()
    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting
resetVotes()
voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

task.wait(20) -- Voting period
local winningMap = getWinningMap()
print("Winning map: " .. winningMap)

instruction: Script for use BindableEvents for server-to-server script communication.
output:
-- BindableEvents allow communication between server scripts
-- (Unlike RemoteEvents which are client-server)

-- Create or reference a BindableEvent
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
bindable.Name = "GameEvent"
bindable.Parent = ServerStorage

-- Script A: Fire the event
local gameEvent = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("GameEvent")
gameEvent:Fire("roundStart", {map = "Desert", time = 60})

-- Script B: Listen for the event
local gameEvent = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("GameEvent")
gameEvent.Event:Connect(function(eventType, data)
    if eventType == "roundStart" then
        print("Starting round on " .. data.map)
    end
end)

-- BindableFunctions for request/response between scripts
local bindableFunc = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
bindableFunc.Name = "GetData"
bindableFunc.Parent = ServerStorage

-- Script A: Handle invocations
bindableFunc.OnInvoke = function(key)
    if key == "playerCount" then
        return #game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
    end
    return nil
end

-- Script B: Invoke and get result
local count = bindableFunc:Invoke("playerCount")
print("Players online: " .. count)
