instruction: Code a script that a simple ragdoll system that activates when the player dies.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function enableRagdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
    
    for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            
            a0.CFrame = joint.C0
            a1.CFrame = joint.C1
            a0.Parent = joint.Part0
            a1.Parent = joint.Part1
            
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.Parent = joint.Parent
            
            joint.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            enableRagdoll(character)
        end)
    end)
end)

local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 40

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)

instruction: Build a system that a simple ragdoll system that activates when the player dies.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function enableRagdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
    
    for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            
            a0.CFrame = joint.C0
            a1.CFrame = joint.C1
            a0.Parent = joint.Part0
            a1.Parent = joint.Part1
            
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.Parent = joint.Parent
            
            joint.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            enableRagdoll(character)
        end)
    end)
end)

instruction: How do I make a kill/death tracking system.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function setupLeaderstats(player)
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local kills = Instance.new("IntValue")
    kills.Name = "Kills"
    kills.Value = 0
    kills.Parent = leaderstats
    
    local deaths = Instance.new("IntValue")
    deaths.Name = "Deaths"
    deaths.Value = 0
    deaths.Parent = leaderstats
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        -- Increment deaths
        player.leaderstats.Deaths.Value = player.leaderstats.Deaths.Value + 1
        
        -- Find the killer using the damage tag
        local creator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
        if creator and creator.Value then
            local killer = creator.Value
            if killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player then
                killer.leaderstats.Kills.Value = killer.leaderstats.Kills.Value + 1
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    setupLeaderstats(player)
    
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    end)
end)

-- To tag a kill (call this when a weapon damages someone):
local function tagHumanoid(humanoid, attacker)
    local creator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
    if not creator then
        creator = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
        creator.Name = "creator"
        creator.Parent = humanoid
    end
    creator.Value = attacker
    
    -- Remove tag after 3 seconds
    task.delay(3, function()
        if creator and creator.Parent then
            creator:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Code a script that prevent exploiters from cheating with RemoteEvents.
output:
-- Never trust the client! Always validate on the server.

-- BAD: Trusting client data
remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, coins)
    player.leaderstats.Coins.Value = coins -- Exploiter can send any value!
end)

-- GOOD: Server-side validation
remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
    -- Validate the action is legitimate
    if action ~= "collectCoin" then return end
    
    -- Server determines the reward, not the client
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end
    
    -- Check if player is actually near a coin
    local nearestCoin = nil
    for _, coin in pairs(workspace.Coins:GetChildren()) do
        if (coin.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude < 10 then
            nearestCoin = coin
            break
        end
    end
    
    if nearestCoin then
        nearestCoin:Destroy()
        player.leaderstats.Coins.Value = player.leaderstats.Coins.Value + 1
    end
end)

-- Also implement rate limiting
local lastAction = {}
remoteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, ...)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lastAction[player.UserId] and now - lastAction[player.UserId] < 0.1 then
        return -- Too fast, likely exploiting
    end
    lastAction[player.UserId] = now
    
    -- Process normally
end)

instruction: Show me how to a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 100 dealing 20 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 20
local speed = 100
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)

-- If/elseif/else
local health = 75
if health > 80 then
    print("Healthy")
elseif health > 40 then
    print("Wounded")
elseif health > 0 then
    print("Critical")
else
    print("Dead")
end

-- Ternary-like pattern (Luau)
local status = if health > 50 then "Alive" else "Dying"

-- For loop (numeric)
for i = 1, 10 do
    print(i)
end

-- For loop with step
for i = 10, 1, -1 do
    print(i) -- Countdown
end

-- While loop
local count = 0
while count < 5 do
    count = count + 1
    print(count)
end

-- Repeat/until
repeat
    count = count - 1
until count <= 0

-- Continue (Luau feature)
for i = 1, 10 do
    if i % 2 == 0 then
        continue -- Skip even numbers
    end
    print(i) -- Only odd numbers
end

-- Break

    if i > 10 then
        break
    end
    print(i)
end

					if speed > MAX_SPEED then

instruction: How do I a round-based game system with 60s rounds and 20s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 60
local INTERMISSION = 20

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create collision groups
PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup("Players")
PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup("Default")

PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Players", "Players", false)

-- Assign player parts to the group
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CollisionGroup = "Players"
            end
        end
        
        character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant.CollisionGroup = "Players"
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins")

local function addCoins(userId, amount)
    local success, newValue = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(oldValue)
            local currentCoins = oldValue or 0
            return currentCoins + amount
        end)
    end)
    
    if success then
        print("Coins updated to: " .. newValue)
        return newValue
    else
        warn("Failed to update coins for user " .. userId)
        return nil
    end
end

instruction: How do I Raycast from the mouse position to detect what the player is looking at.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function getMouseRaycast()
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local unitRay = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(unitRay.Origin, unitRay.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
    
    return result
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        local result = getMouseRaycast()
        if result then
            print("Clicked on: " .. result.Instance.Name)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Make a script that a Sword tool that deals 50 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Track active connections and data per player
local playerConnections = {}
local playerData = {}

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    playerConnections[player] = {}
    playerData[player] = {
        score = 0,
        startTime = os.clock()
    }
    
    -- Store connections so we can clean them up
    local connections = playerConnections[player]
    
    table.insert(connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        
        table.insert(connections, humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            print(player.Name .. " died")
        end))
    end))
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    -- Save data before cleanup
    local data = playerData[player]
    if data then
        data.totalPlayTime = os.clock() - data.startTime
        -- Save to DataStore here
    end
    
    -- Disconnect all connections
    local connections = playerConnections[player]
    if connections then
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    
    -- Clean up references
    playerConnections[player] = nil
    playerData[player] = nil
end)

    end
end)

local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local HOME_POSITION = rootPart.Position
local WAIT_TIME_MIN = 2
local WAIT_TIME_MAX = 6

local function getRandomPoint()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random() * WANDER_RADIUS
    
    return HOME_POSITION + Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )
end

local function wanderTo(position)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
    })
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, position)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then break end
        end
    end
end

-- Wander loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getRandomPoint()
    wanderTo(target)
    
    local waitTime = math.random(WAIT_TIME_MIN, WAIT_TIME_MAX)
    task.wait(waitTime)
end

output:
-- Fill a region with terrain material
local terrain = workspace.Terrain

-- Fill a block region
local regionStart = Vector3.new(-100, 0, -100)
local regionEnd = Vector3.new(100, 10, 100)
local region = Region3.new(regionStart, regionEnd)
region = region:ExpandToGrid(4) -- Terrain uses a 4-stud grid

terrain:FillRegion(region, 4, Enum.Material.Grass)

-- Fill a sphere
terrain:FillBall(Vector3.new(0, 20, 0), 15, Enum.Material.Rock)

-- Fill a cylinder
terrain:FillCylinder(
    CFrame.new(0, 5, 0),
    20,   -- height
    10,   -- radius
    Enum.Material.Sand
)

-- Fill a wedge
terrain:FillWedge(
    CFrame.new(50, 10, 0),
    Vector3.new(20, 20, 20),
    Enum.Material.Slate
)

-- Procedural terrain with math.noise
local RESOLUTION = 4
local AMPLITUDE = 30
local FREQUENCY = 0.02

for x = -200, 200, RESOLUTION do
    for z = -200, 200, RESOLUTION do
        local height = math.noise(x * FREQUENCY, z * FREQUENCY) * AMPLITUDE + 20
        
        local region = Region3.new(
            Vector3.new(x, 0, z),
            Vector3.new(x + RESOLUTION, height, z + RESOLUTION)
        ):ExpandToGrid(4)
        
        -- Layer different materials by height
        local material
        if height < 10 then
            material = Enum.Material.Sand
        elseif height < 25 then
            material = Enum.Material.Grass
        elseif height < 35 then
            material = Enum.Material.Rock
        else
            material = Enum.Material.Snow
        end
        
        terrain:FillRegion(region, 4, material)
    end
end

instruction: Give me a script for a map voting system where players can vote for one of three maps.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local maps = {"Desert", "Forest", "City"}
local votes = {}
local playerVotes = {}

local voteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
voteEvent.Name = "VoteEvent"
voteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function resetVotes()
    votes = {}
    for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
        votes[mapName] = 0
    end
    playerVotes = {}
end

local function getWinningMap()
    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting
resetVotes()
voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

task.wait(20) -- Voting period
local winningMap = getWinningMap()
print("Winning map: " .. winningMap)

output:
-- Simple boolean debounce
local debounce = false

local function onTouch(hit)
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    -- Do something
    print("Touched!")
    
    task.wait(1)
    debounce = false
end

-- Per-player debounce
local playerDebounce = {}

local function onPlayerTouch(player)
    if playerDebounce[player.UserId] then return end
    playerDebounce[player.UserId] = true
    
    print(player.Name .. " activated!")
    
    task.delay(2, function()
        playerDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end)
end

-- Throttle pattern (limit calls per time window)
local function throttle(func, interval)
    local lastCall = 0
    return function(...)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCall >= interval then
            lastCall = now
            return func(...)
        end
    end
end

local throttledPrint = throttle(function(msg)
    print(msg)
end, 1)

-- Cooldown with visual feedback
local function createCooldown(duration)
    local isReady = true
    local remaining = 0
    
    return {
        use = function()
            if not isReady then return false end
            isReady = false
            remaining = duration
            
            task.spawn(function()
                while remaining > 0 do
                    remaining = remaining - task.wait()
                end
                remaining = 0
                isReady = true
            end)
            
            return true
        end,
        isReady = function() return isReady end,
        getRemaining = function() return remaining end
    }
end

instruction: How do I create a state machine for NPC AI in Roblox Luau?
output:
local SM = {}
SM.__index = SM

function SM.new(init)
	return setmetatable({Current=init, States={}, Trans={}}, SM)
end

function SM:AddState(name, cbs) self.States[name] = cbs end

function SM:AddTransition(from, to, cond)
	self.Trans[from] = self.Trans[from] or {}
	table.insert(self.Trans[from], {To=to, Cond=cond})
end

function SM:GoTo(state)
	local old = self.States[self.Current]
	if old and old.Exit then old.Exit() end
	self.Current = state
	local new = self.States[state]
	if new and new.Enter then new.Enter() end
end

function SM:Update(dt)
	local ts = self.Trans[self.Current]
	if ts then for _,t in ts do if t.Cond() then self:GoTo(t.To); return end end end
	local s = self.States[self.Current]
	if s and s.Update then s.Update(dt) end
end

return SM

instruction: Implement a way to a camera shake effect for explosions or impacts.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local shakeData = {
    intensity = 0,
    duration = 0,
    elapsed = 0,
    active = false
}

local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    shakeData.intensity = intensity
    shakeData.duration = duration
    shakeData.elapsed = 0
    shakeData.active = true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not shakeData.active then return end
    
    shakeData.elapsed = shakeData.elapsed + dt
    
    if shakeData.elapsed >= shakeData.duration then
        shakeData.active = false
        return
    end
    
    local progress = shakeData.elapsed / shakeData.duration
    local currentIntensity = shakeData.intensity * (1 - progress)
    
    local offsetX = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetY = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetZ = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    
    camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsetX, offsetY, offsetZ)
end)

-- Usage: shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
-- shakeCamera(2, 0.5) -- Strong, short shake
-- shakeCamera(0.5, 2) -- Mild, long shake

-- For loop (numeric)
for i = 1, 10 do
    print(i)
end

-- For loop with step
for i = 10, 1, -1 do
    print(i) -- Countdown
end

-- While loop
local count = 0
while count < 5 do
    count = count + 1
    print(count)
end

-- Repeat/until
repeat
    count = count - 1
until count <= 0

-- Continue (Luau feature)

    if i % 2 == 0 then
        continue -- Skip even numbers
    end
    print(i) -- Only odd numbers
end

    end
    print(i)
end

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 100 dealing 30 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local speed = 100
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Give me a script for a ModuleScript that implements a simple inventory system.
output:
-- ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage
local InventoryModule = {}

local inventories = {}

function InventoryModule.create(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = {
        items = {},
        maxSlots = 20
    }
end

function InventoryModule.addItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false, "No inventory" end
    
    if inv.items[itemName] then
        inv.items[itemName] = inv.items[itemName] + (quantity or 1)
    else
        -- Check slot limit
        local slotCount = 0
        for _ in pairs(inv.items) do
            slotCount = slotCount + 1
        end
        
        if slotCount >= inv.maxSlots then
            return false, "Inventory full"
        end
        
        inv.items[itemName] = quantity or 1
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.removeItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    
    local current = inv.items[itemName]
    if not current then return false end
    
    local removeAmount = quantity or 1
    if current <= removeAmount then
        inv.items[itemName] = nil
    else
        inv.items[itemName] = current - removeAmount
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.getItems(player)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return {} end
    return inv.items
end

function InventoryModule.hasItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    return (inv.items[itemName] or 0) >= (quantity or 1)
end

function InventoryModule.destroy(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = nil
end

return InventoryModule

instruction: Help me make a door that opens and closes.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local door = script.Parent
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Open Door"
prompt.HoldDuration = 0
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
prompt.Parent = door

local isOpen = false
local isTweening = false

local closedCFrame = door.CFrame
local openCFrame = closedCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0) * CFrame.new(-door.Size.X / 2, 0, door.Size.X / 2)

local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
    if isTweening then return end
    isTweening = true
    
    local targetCFrame
    if isOpen then
        targetCFrame = closedCFrame
        prompt.ActionText = "Open Door"
    else
        targetCFrame = openCFrame
        prompt.ActionText = "Close Door"
    end
    
    local tween = TweenService:Create(door, tweenInfo, {
        CFrame = targetCFrame
    })
    tween:Play()
    tween.Completed:Wait()
    
    isOpen = not isOpen
    isTweening = false
end)

instruction: How do I create a minimap in Roblox Luau?
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local mm = Instance.new("Frame")
mm.Size = UDim2.new(0,200,0,200)
mm.Position = UDim2.new(1,-210,0,10)
mm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,40,20)
mm.ClipsDescendants = true
mm.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner",mm).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5,0)
local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
dot.Size = UDim2.new(0,8,0,8)
dot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-4,0.5,-4)
dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
dot.Parent = mm
Instance.new("UICorner",dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
local SCALE = 2
local dots = {}
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local c = player.Character
	if not c then return end
	local rp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not rp then return end
	for _,op in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if op ~= player then
			local oc = op.Character
			local or2 = oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if or2 then
				if not dots[op] then
					local d = Instance.new("Frame")
					d.Size = UDim2.new(0,6,0,6)
					d.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)
					Instance.new("UICorner",d).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
					d.Parent = mm
					dots[op] = d
				end
				local off = or2.Position - rp.Position
				local px = 0.5 + off.X*SCALE/200
				local py = 0.5 + off.Z*SCALE/200
				dots[op].Position = UDim2.new(px,-3,py,-3)
				dots[op].Visible = px>0 and px<1 and py>0 and py<1
			else
				if dots[op] then dots[op].Visible = false end
			end
		end
	end
end)

instruction: Write a DataStore script to save and load a player's Deaths value.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local deaths = 0
    if success and data then
        deaths = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Deaths"
    stat.Value = deaths
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Deaths")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Deaths for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Deaths")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: How do I create a damage number popup in Roblox Luau?
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local function showDamage(pos, dmg, crit)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.new(4,0,2,0)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-10,10)/10, 0, math.random(-10,10)/10)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bb.MaxDistance = 50
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = tostring(math.floor(dmg))..(crit and "!" or "")
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = crit and Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50) or Color3.new(1,1,1)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
	label.Parent = bb
	local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
	anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
	anchor.Position = pos
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	anchor.CanCollide = false
	anchor.Anchored = true
	anchor.Parent = workspace
	bb.Parent = anchor
	TweenService:Create(anchor, TweenInfo.new(1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position=pos+Vector3.new(0,4,0)}):Play()
	local fade = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.In,0,false,0.5), {TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1})
	fade:Play()
	fade.Completed:Connect(function() anchor:Destroy() end)
end

return showDamage

instruction: Give the player a ForceField that lasts 15 seconds.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 15)
    end)
end)

instruction: Show different debounce patterns used in Roblox development.
output:
-- Simple boolean debounce
local debounce = false

local function onTouch(hit)
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    -- Do something
    print("Touched!")
    
    task.wait(1)
    debounce = false
end

-- Per-player debounce
local playerDebounce = {}

local function onPlayerTouch(player)
    if playerDebounce[player.UserId] then return end
    playerDebounce[player.UserId] = true
    
    print(player.Name .. " activated!")
    
    task.delay(2, function()
        playerDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end)
end

-- Throttle pattern (limit calls per time window)
local function throttle(func, interval)
    local lastCall = 0
    return function(...)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCall >= interval then
            lastCall = now
            return func(...)
        end
    end
end

local throttledPrint = throttle(function(msg)
    print(msg)
end, 1)

-- Cooldown with visual feedback
local function createCooldown(duration)
    local isReady = true
    local remaining = 0
    
    return {
        use = function()
            if not isReady then return false end
            isReady = false
            remaining = duration
            
            task.spawn(function()
                while remaining > 0 do
                    remaining = remaining - task.wait()
                end
                remaining = 0
                isReady = true
            end)
            
            return true
        end,
        isReady = function() return isReady end,
        getRemaining = function() return remaining end
    }
end

instruction: Create a Hammer tool that deals 15 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 15
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 100 dealing 10 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 10
local speed = 100
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: What's the code to an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)

instruction: How do I What is the difference between CFrame and Vector3.
output:
-- Vector3: Represents a point or direction in 3D space (x, y, z)
local position = Vector3.new(10, 5, 20)
local direction = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) -- Pointing up

-- Useful Vector3 operations
print(position.Magnitude)  -- Distance from origin
print(position.Unit)       -- Normalized direction
print(position + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))  -- Addition
print(position:Dot(direction))  -- Dot product
print(position:Cross(direction)) -- Cross product

-- CFrame: Represents a position AND rotation (orientation) in 3D space
local cf = CFrame.new(10, 5, 20)  -- Position only
local cfRotated = CFrame.new(10, 5, 20) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)

-- CFrame has both position and look direction
print(cf.Position)      -- Vector3
print(cf.LookVector)    -- Forward direction
print(cf.RightVector)   -- Right direction
print(cf.UpVector)      -- Up direction

-- Key difference: Use Vector3 for positions/math, CFrame for positioning + rotating objects
local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)  -- Sets position only
part.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 10, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0)  -- Sets position AND rotation

instruction: Create a global leaderboard using OrderedDataStore for top players by Level.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("LevelLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Level")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

instruction: Give me a script for What is the difference between a Script and a LocalScript in Roblox.
output:
Scripts and LocalScripts serve different purposes in Roblox:

**Script (Server Script):**
- Runs on the server
- Has access to server-side services (DataStoreService, ServerStorage, etc.)
- Can modify the game for all players
- Cannot access client-only services (UserInputService, camera, etc.)
- Placed in ServerScriptService, Workspace, or parts

**LocalScript (Client Script):**
- Runs on each player's client individually
- Has access to client services (UserInputService, camera, PlayerGui, etc.)
- Changes are only visible to that specific player
- Cannot directly access ServerStorage or server-side DataStores
- Placed in StarterPlayerScripts, StarterCharacterScripts, or PlayerGui

Communication between them uses RemoteEvents and RemoteFunctions.

instruction: Show error handling patterns in Luau with pcall and xpcall.
output:
-- Basic pcall
local success, result = pcall(function()
    return 10 / 0
end)

if success then
    print("Result: " .. result)
else
    warn("Error: " .. tostring(result))
end

-- pcall with arguments
local success, data = pcall(function()
    local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
    local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
    return store:GetAsync("Player_123")
end)

-- xpcall with custom error handler
local success, result = xpcall(
    function()
        error("Something went wrong!")
    end,
    function(err)
        warn("Caught error: " .. err)
        warn(debug.traceback())
        return "Error handled"
    end
)

-- Retry pattern
local function withRetry(func, maxAttempts, delay)
    for attempt = 1, maxAttempts do
        local success, result = pcall(func)
        if success then
            return result
        end
        
        if attempt < maxAttempts then
            warn("Attempt " .. attempt .. " failed, retrying...")
            task.wait(delay)
        else
            warn("All " .. maxAttempts .. " attempts failed")
            return nil
        end
    end
end

-- Custom error types
local function validateInput(value)
    if typeof(value) ~= "number" then
        error({
            code = "INVALID_TYPE",
            message = "Expected number, got " .. typeof(value)
        })
    end
    if value < 0 then
        error({
            code = "OUT_OF_RANGE",
            message = "Value must be non-negative"
        })
    end
    return value
end

    end

end

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 300s rounds and 20s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 300
local INTERMISSION = 20

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Implement an OOP class pattern in Luau for a game entity.
output:
-- ModuleScript: Entity
local Entity = {}
Entity.__index = Entity

export type EntityData = {
    name: string,
    health: number,
    maxHealth: number,
    damage: number,
    speed: number,
}

function Entity.new(data: EntityData)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Entity)
    self.name = data.name
    self.health = data.health or 100
    self.maxHealth = data.maxHealth or 100
    self.damage = data.damage or 10
    self.speed = data.speed or 16
    self.isAlive = true
    self.effects = {}
    return self
end

function Entity:takeDamage(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    
    self.health = math.max(0, self.health - amount)
    
    if self.health <= 0 then
        self.isAlive = false
        self:onDeath()
    end
end

function Entity:heal(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    self.health = math.min(self.maxHealth, self.health + amount)
end

function Entity:addEffect(effectName: string, duration: number)
    self.effects[effectName] = {
        startTime = os.clock(),
        duration = duration
    }
end

function Entity:hasEffect(effectName: string): boolean
    local effect = self.effects[effectName]
    if not effect then return false end
    
    if os.clock() - effect.startTime > effect.duration then
        self.effects[effectName] = nil
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

function Entity:onDeath()
    print(self.name .. " has been defeated!")
end

function Entity:getHealthPercentage(): number
    return self.health / self.maxHealth
end

return Entity

output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local speed = 50
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 120s rounds and 20s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 120
local INTERMISSION = 20

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 300s rounds and 30s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 300
local INTERMISSION = 30

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to an NPC that pathfinds to the nearest player.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FOLLOW_RANGE = 100
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.5

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDist = FOLLOW_RANGE
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest = character
                    nearestDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

local function moveTo(targetPosition)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
    })
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Main AI loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if target then
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            moveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
end

instruction: What's the code to Show error handling patterns in Luau with pcall and xpcall.
output:
-- Basic pcall
local success, result = pcall(function()
    return 10 / 0
end)

if success then
    print("Result: " .. result)
else
    warn("Error: " .. tostring(result))
end

-- pcall with arguments
local success, data = pcall(function()
    local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
    local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
    return store:GetAsync("Player_123")
end)

-- xpcall with custom error handler
local success, result = xpcall(
    function()
        error("Something went wrong!")
    end,
    function(err)
        warn("Caught error: " .. err)
        warn(debug.traceback())
        return "Error handled"
    end
)

-- Retry pattern
local function withRetry(func, maxAttempts, delay)
    for attempt = 1, maxAttempts do
        local success, result = pcall(func)
        if success then
            return result
        end
        
        if attempt < maxAttempts then
            warn("Attempt " .. attempt .. " failed, retrying...")
            task.wait(delay)
        else
            warn("All " .. maxAttempts .. " attempts failed")
            return nil
        end
    end
end

-- Custom error types
local function validateInput(value)
    if typeof(value) ~= "number" then
        error({
            code = "INVALID_TYPE",
            message = "Expected number, got " .. typeof(value)
        })
    end
    if value < 0 then
        error({
            code = "OUT_OF_RANGE",
            message = "Value must be non-negative"
        })
    end
    return value
end

instruction: Make a script that a custom chat command that handles '/give' to give items to players.
output:
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local textChatCommands = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChatCommands", 5)
if not textChatCommands then
    textChatCommands = Instance.new("Folder")
    textChatCommands.Name = "TextChatCommands"
    textChatCommands.Parent = TextChatService
end

local giveCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
giveCommand.Name = "GiveCommand"
giveCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/give"
giveCommand.SecondaryAlias = "/g"
giveCommand.Parent = textChatCommands

giveCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
    if not player then return end
    
    local args = string.split(message, " ")
    -- /give PlayerName ItemName
    if #args >= 3 then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local itemName = args[3]
        
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(p.Name):find(string.lower(targetName)) then
                targetPlayer = p
                break
            end
        end
        
        if targetPlayer then
            print(player.Name .. " gave " .. itemName .. " to " .. targetPlayer.Name)
        end
    end
end)

        )
    end
end)

output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local function castRay()
    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 50
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    if result then
        print("Hit: " .. result.Instance:GetFullName())
        print("Position: " .. tostring(result.Position))
        print("Normal: " .. tostring(result.Normal))
        print("Distance: " .. tostring(result.Distance))
        return result
    end
    
    return nil
end

instruction: Create a Bow tool that deals 15 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 15
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function getMouseRaycast()
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local unitRay = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(unitRay.Origin, unitRay.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
    
    return result
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        local result = getMouseRaycast()
        if result then
            print("Clicked on: " .. result.Instance.Name)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Create a map voting system where players can vote for one of three maps.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local maps = {"Desert", "Forest", "City"}
local votes = {}
local playerVotes = {}

local voteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
voteEvent.Name = "VoteEvent"
voteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function resetVotes()
    votes = {}
    for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
        votes[mapName] = 0
    end
    playerVotes = {}
end

local function getWinningMap()
    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting
resetVotes()
voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

task.wait(20) -- Voting period
local winningMap = getWinningMap()
print("Winning map: " .. winningMap)

instruction: Show me how to a camera shake effect for explosions or impacts.
output:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local shakeData = {
    intensity = 0,
    duration = 0,
    elapsed = 0,
    active = false
}

local function shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
    shakeData.intensity = intensity
    shakeData.duration = duration
    shakeData.elapsed = 0
    shakeData.active = true
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not shakeData.active then return end
    
    shakeData.elapsed = shakeData.elapsed + dt
    
    if shakeData.elapsed >= shakeData.duration then
        shakeData.active = false
        return
    end
    
    local progress = shakeData.elapsed / shakeData.duration
    local currentIntensity = shakeData.intensity * (1 - progress)
    
    local offsetX = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetY = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    local offsetZ = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * currentIntensity
    
    camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(offsetX, offsetY, offsetZ)
end)

-- Usage: shakeCamera(intensity, duration)
-- shakeCamera(2, 0.5) -- Strong, short shake
-- shakeCamera(0.5, 2) -- Mild, long shake

--   - The object might not exist and that's okay
--   - You need non-blocking code
--   - You're checking for optional features

--   - The object will definitely exist but might not have loaded yet
--   - At the start of scripts waiting for the game to load
--   - Loading assets from ReplicatedStorage or ServerStorage

instruction: Write a Roblox script to a ModuleScript that implements a simple inventory system.
output:
-- ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage
local InventoryModule = {}

local inventories = {}

function InventoryModule.create(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = {
        items = {},
        maxSlots = 20
    }
end

function InventoryModule.addItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false, "No inventory" end
    
    if inv.items[itemName] then
        inv.items[itemName] = inv.items[itemName] + (quantity or 1)
    else
        -- Check slot limit
        local slotCount = 0
        for _ in pairs(inv.items) do
            slotCount = slotCount + 1
        end
        
        if slotCount >= inv.maxSlots then
            return false, "Inventory full"
        end
        
        inv.items[itemName] = quantity or 1
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.removeItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    
    local current = inv.items[itemName]
    if not current then return false end
    
    local removeAmount = quantity or 1
    if current <= removeAmount then
        inv.items[itemName] = nil
    else
        inv.items[itemName] = current - removeAmount
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.getItems(player)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return {} end
    return inv.items
end

function InventoryModule.hasItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    return (inv.items[itemName] or 0) >= (quantity or 1)
end

function InventoryModule.destroy(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = nil
end

return InventoryModule

        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then

    end

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 120s rounds and 15s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 120
local INTERMISSION = 15

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 200 dealing 30 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local speed = 200
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: What's the code to a round-based game system with 90s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 90
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: How do I make a kill/death tracking system?
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function setupLeaderstats(player)
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local kills = Instance.new("IntValue")
    kills.Name = "Kills"
    kills.Value = 0
    kills.Parent = leaderstats
    
    local deaths = Instance.new("IntValue")
    deaths.Name = "Deaths"
    deaths.Value = 0
    deaths.Parent = leaderstats
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        -- Increment deaths
        player.leaderstats.Deaths.Value = player.leaderstats.Deaths.Value + 1
        
        -- Find the killer using the damage tag
        local creator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
        if creator and creator.Value then
            local killer = creator.Value
            if killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player then
                killer.leaderstats.Kills.Value = killer.leaderstats.Kills.Value + 1
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    setupLeaderstats(player)
    
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        onCharacterAdded(player, character)
    end)
end)

-- To tag a kill (call this when a weapon damages someone):
local function tagHumanoid(humanoid, attacker)
    local creator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
    if not creator then
        creator = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
        creator.Name = "creator"
        creator.Parent = humanoid
    end
    creator.Value = attacker
    
    -- Remove tag after 3 seconds
    task.delay(3, function()
        if creator and creator.Parent then
            creator:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Help me a map voting system where players can vote for one of three maps.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local maps = {"Desert", "Forest", "City"}
local votes = {}
local playerVotes = {}

local voteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
voteEvent.Name = "VoteEvent"
voteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function resetVotes()
    votes = {}
    for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
        votes[mapName] = 0
    end
    playerVotes = {}
end

local function getWinningMap()
    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting
resetVotes()
voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

task.wait(20) -- Voting period
local winningMap = getWinningMap()
print("Winning map: " .. winningMap)

instruction: Write a Roblox script to an auto-balancing team system that assigns players to Red or Blue teams.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")

-- Create teams
local redTeam = Instance.new("Team")
redTeam.Name = "Red"
redTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
redTeam.AutoAssignable = false
redTeam.Parent = Teams

local blueTeam = Instance.new("Team")
blueTeam.Name = "Blue"
blueTeam.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue")
blueTeam.AutoAssignable = false
blueTeam.Parent = Teams

local function getTeamCount(team)
    local count = 0
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Team == team then
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return count
end

local function assignTeam(player)
    local redCount = getTeamCount(redTeam)
    local blueCount = getTeamCount(blueTeam)
    
    if redCount <= blueCount then
        player.Team = redTeam
    else
        player.Team = blueTeam
    end
    
    -- Color the character
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(0.1)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                part.Color = player.TeamColor.Color
            end
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(assignTeam)
