instruction: Implement a way to a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 100 dealing 20 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 20
local speed = 100
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to a round-based game system with 120s rounds and 5s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 120
local INTERMISSION = 5

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Implement create a state machine for NPC AI in Roblox
output:
local SM = {}
SM.__index = SM

function SM.new(init)
	return setmetatable({Current=init, States={}, Trans={}}, SM)
end

function SM:AddState(name, cbs) self.States[name] = cbs end

function SM:AddTransition(from, to, cond)
	self.Trans[from] = self.Trans[from] or {}
	table.insert(self.Trans[from], {To=to, Cond=cond})
end

function SM:GoTo(state)
	local old = self.States[self.Current]
	if old and old.Exit then old.Exit() end
	self.Current = state
	local new = self.States[state]
	if new and new.Enter then new.Enter() end
end

function SM:Update(dt)
	local ts = self.Trans[self.Current]
	if ts then for _,t in ts do if t.Cond() then self:GoTo(t.To); return end end end
	local s = self.States[self.Current]
	if s and s.Update then s.Update(dt) end
end

return SM

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

instruction: What's the code to Cast a ray from the player's camera in the look direction for 100 studs.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local function castRay()
    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 100
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    if result then
        print("Hit: " .. result.Instance:GetFullName())
        print("Position: " .. tostring(result.Position))
        print("Normal: " .. tostring(result.Normal))
        print("Distance: " .. tostring(result.Distance))
        return result
    end
    
    return nil
end

instruction: Script for a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 50 dealing 50 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local speed = 50
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Set up collision groups so players don't collide with each other.
output:
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create collision groups
PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup("Players")
PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup("Default")

-- Disable collision between players
PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Players", "Players", false)

-- Assign player parts to the group
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CollisionGroup = "Players"
            end
        end
        
        character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant.CollisionGroup = "Players"
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

instruction: Make a script that an NPC that pathfinds to the nearest player.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FOLLOW_RANGE = 100
local UPDATE_INTERVAL = 0.5

local function getNearestPlayer()
    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDist = FOLLOW_RANGE
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        if character then
            local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if targetRoot then
                local dist = (targetRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if dist < nearestDist then
                    nearest = character
                    nearestDist = dist
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return nearest
end

local function moveTo(targetPosition)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
        AgentCanClimb = false,
    })
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, targetPosition)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
        
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(waypoints) do
            if waypoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then
                break
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Main AI loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getNearestPlayer()
    
    if target then
        local targetRoot = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            moveTo(targetRoot.Position)
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(UPDATE_INTERVAL)
end

local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local speed = 50
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile

        local targetChar = hit.Parent

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 60s rounds and 15s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 60
local INTERMISSION = 15

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

instruction: Code a script that a map voting system where players can vote for one of three maps.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local maps = {"Desert", "Forest", "City"}
local votes = {}
local playerVotes = {}

local voteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
voteEvent.Name = "VoteEvent"
voteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function resetVotes()
    votes = {}
    for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
        votes[mapName] = 0
    end
    playerVotes = {}
end

local function getWinningMap()
    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting
resetVotes()
voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

task.wait(20) -- Voting period
local winningMap = getWinningMap()
print("Winning map: " .. winningMap)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

        giveForceField(player, 5)
    end)
end)

instruction: Create a Pickaxe tool that deals 15 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 15
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Can you write code to Use CollectionService to tag and manage groups of objects.
output:
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

-- Tag objects
local function setupLava(part)
    part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local character = hit.Parent
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:TakeDamage(10)
        end
    end)
end

-- Apply behavior to all tagged objects
for _, part in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Lava")) do
    setupLava(part)
end

-- Handle objects added at runtime
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Lava"):Connect(function(part)
    setupLava(part)
end)

CollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal("Lava"):Connect(function(part)
    print(part.Name .. " is no longer lava")
end)

-- Tag management
local function addTag(instance, tag)
    CollectionService:AddTag(instance, tag)
end

local function removeTag(instance, tag)
    CollectionService:RemoveTag(instance, tag)
end

local function hasTag(instance, tag)
    return CollectionService:HasTag(instance, tag)
end

-- Example: Collectible coins
for _, coin in pairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Coin")) do
    coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
        if player then
            local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
            if ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Coins") then
                ls.Coins.Value = ls.Coins.Value + 1
            end
            coin:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

instruction: Make a script that use BindableEvents for server-to-server script communication.
output:
-- BindableEvents allow communication between server scripts
-- (Unlike RemoteEvents which are client-server)

-- Create or reference a BindableEvent
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local bindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
bindable.Name = "GameEvent"
bindable.Parent = ServerStorage

-- Script A: Fire the event
local gameEvent = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("GameEvent")
gameEvent:Fire("roundStart", {map = "Desert", time = 60})

-- Script B: Listen for the event
local gameEvent = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("GameEvent")
gameEvent.Event:Connect(function(eventType, data)
    if eventType == "roundStart" then
        print("Starting round on " .. data.map)
    end
end)

-- BindableFunctions for request/response between scripts
local bindableFunc = Instance.new("BindableFunction")
bindableFunc.Name = "GetData"
bindableFunc.Parent = ServerStorage

-- Script A: Handle invocations
bindableFunc.OnInvoke = function(key)
    if key == "playerCount" then
        return #game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
    end
    return nil
end

-- Script B: Invoke and get result
local count = bindableFunc:Invoke("playerCount")
print("Players online: " .. count)

instruction: Create a global leaderboard using OrderedDataStore for top players by Wins.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("WinsLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Wins")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins")

local function addCoins(userId, amount)
    local success, newValue = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(oldValue)
            local currentCoins = oldValue or 0
            return currentCoins + amount
        end)
    end)
    
    if success then
        print("Coins updated to: " .. newValue)
        return newValue
    else
        warn("Failed to update coins for user " .. userId)
        return nil
    end
end

instruction: How do I create a simple crafting system in Roblox Luau?
output:
local Crafting = {}
local recipes = {
	["Iron Sword"] = {{Name="Iron Ingot",Qty=3},{Name="Wood",Qty=1}},
	["Health Potion"] = {{Name="Red Herb",Qty=2},{Name="Water",Qty=1}},
}

function Crafting.canCraft(inv, name)
	local r = recipes[name]
	if not r then return false end
	for _,ing in r do
		if not inv:HasItem(ing.Name, ing.Qty) then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Crafting.craft(inv, name)
	if not Crafting.canCraft(inv, name) then return false end
	for _,ing in recipes[name] do
		inv:RemoveItem(ing.Name, ing.Qty)
	end
	inv:AddItem(name, 1)
	return true

instruction: Show me how to an NPC that wanders randomly within a defined area.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local HOME_POSITION = rootPart.Position
local WAIT_TIME_MIN = 2
local WAIT_TIME_MAX = 6

local function getRandomPoint()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random() * WANDER_RADIUS
    
    return HOME_POSITION + Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )
end

local function wanderTo(position)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
    })
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, position)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then break end
        end
    end
end

-- Wander loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getRandomPoint()
    wanderTo(target)
    
    local waitTime = math.random(WAIT_TIME_MIN, WAIT_TIME_MAX)
    task.wait(waitTime)
end

    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting

voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("ScoreLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Score")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local PRODUCT_ID = 0 -- Replace with your Developer Product ID

local function promptPurchase(player)
    MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, PRODUCT_ID)
end

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
    
    if not player then
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
    end
    
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        -- Grant the product (e.g., add coins)
        local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
        if leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") then
            leaderstats.Coins.Value = leaderstats.Coins.Value + 100
        end
    end)
    
    if success then
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
    else
        warn("Failed to process receipt: " .. err)
        return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
    end
end

instruction: Show me how to Use raycasting to detect if the player is on the ground.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function isOnGround(character)
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return false end
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    
    local origin = rootPart.Position
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    return result ~= nil
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local grounded = isOnGround(character)
        -- Use grounded state for game logic
    end)
end)

instruction: Show me how to a custom chat command that handles '/give' to give items to players.
output:
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local textChatCommands = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChatCommands", 5)
if not textChatCommands then
    textChatCommands = Instance.new("Folder")
    textChatCommands.Name = "TextChatCommands"
    textChatCommands.Parent = TextChatService
end

local giveCommand = Instance.new("TextChatCommand")
giveCommand.Name = "GiveCommand"
giveCommand.PrimaryAlias = "/give"
giveCommand.SecondaryAlias = "/g"
giveCommand.Parent = textChatCommands

giveCommand.Triggered:Connect(function(textSource, message)
    local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(textSource.UserId)
    if not player then return end
    
    local args = string.split(message, " ")
    -- /give PlayerName ItemName
    if #args >= 3 then
        local targetName = args[2]
        local itemName = args[3]
        
        local targetPlayer = nil
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if string.lower(p.Name):find(string.lower(targetName)) then
                targetPlayer = p
                break
            end
        end
        
        if targetPlayer then
            print(player.Name .. " gave " .. itemName .. " to " .. targetPlayer.Name)
        end
    end
end)

local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function filterText(text, fromPlayer, toPlayer)
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        local textObject = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, fromPlayer.UserId)
        
        if toPlayer then
            return textObject:GetChatForUserAsync(toPlayer.UserId)
        else
            return textObject:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
        end
    end)
    
    if success then
        return result
    else
        return "***"
    end
end

-- Usage

print(filtered)

instruction: Show me how to a global leaderboard using OrderedDataStore for top players by Score.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("ScoreLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Score")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

instruction: Create a simple ragdoll system that activates when the player dies.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function enableRagdoll(character)
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
    
    for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            
            a0.CFrame = joint.C0
            a1.CFrame = joint.C1
            a0.Parent = joint.Part0
            a1.Parent = joint.Part1
            
            socket.Attachment0 = a0
            socket.Attachment1 = a1
            socket.LimitsEnabled = true
            socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
            socket.Parent = joint.Parent
            
            joint.Enabled = false
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            enableRagdoll(character)
        end)
    end)
end)

instruction: Write a script to create a save slot system in Roblox
output:
local DSS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MAX_SLOTS = 3
local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
remote.Name = "SaveSlotRemote"
remote.Parent = RS

remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player, action, slot, data)
	if slot < 1 or slot > MAX_SLOTS then return false, "Invalid slot" end
	local store = DSS:GetDataStore("SaveSlot_"..slot)
	local key = "Player_"..player.UserId
	if action == "save" then
		local ok,err = pcall(function() store:SetAsync(key, {Data=data, Time=os.time()}) end)
		return ok, ok and "Saved!" or err
	elseif action == "load" then
		local ok,r = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync(key) end)
		return ok and r ~= nil, r or "No data"
	elseif action == "delete" then
		local ok,err = pcall(function() store:RemoveAsync(key) end)
		return ok, ok and "Deleted!" or err
	end
	return false, "Unknown action"
end

instruction: Write Roblox Luau code to a ModuleScript that implements a simple inventory system.
output:
-- ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage
local InventoryModule = {}

local inventories = {}

function InventoryModule.create(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = {
        items = {},
        maxSlots = 20
    }
end

function InventoryModule.addItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false, "No inventory" end
    
    if inv.items[itemName] then
        inv.items[itemName] = inv.items[itemName] + (quantity or 1)
    else
        -- Check slot limit
        local slotCount = 0
        for _ in pairs(inv.items) do
            slotCount = slotCount + 1
        end
        
        if slotCount >= inv.maxSlots then
            return false, "Inventory full"
        end
        
        inv.items[itemName] = quantity or 1
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.removeItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    
    local current = inv.items[itemName]
    if not current then return false end
    
    local removeAmount = quantity or 1
    if current <= removeAmount then
        inv.items[itemName] = nil
    else
        inv.items[itemName] = current - removeAmount
    end
    
    return true
end

function InventoryModule.getItems(player)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return {} end
    return inv.items
end

function InventoryModule.hasItem(player, itemName, quantity)
    local inv = inventories[player.UserId]
    if not inv then return false end
    return (inv.items[itemName] or 0) >= (quantity or 1)
end

function InventoryModule.destroy(player)
    inventories[player.UserId] = nil
end

return InventoryModule

local part = script.Parent
local debounce = {}

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    local character = hit.Parent
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
    
    if humanoid and player and not debounce[player.UserId] then
        debounce[player.UserId] = true
        
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50
            task.delay(5, function()
                if humanoid then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
                end
            end)
        
        task.wait(1)
        debounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local deaths = 0
    if success and data then
        deaths = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Deaths"
    stat.Value = deaths
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Deaths")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Deaths for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Deaths")

output:
-- task.spawn: Runs a function immediately in a new thread
task.spawn(function()
    print("This runs immediately in a new thread")
    task.wait(5)
    print("This runs after 5 seconds")
end)
print("This also runs immediately, doesn't wait for spawn")

-- task.defer: Runs a function at the end of the current resumption cycle
task.defer(function()
    print("This runs after the current thread yields")
end)
print("This runs first")

-- task.delay: Runs a function after a specified delay
task.delay(3, function()
    print("This runs after 3 seconds")
end)
print("This runs immediately")

-- task.wait: Yields the current thread for a duration (returns actual elapsed time)
local elapsed = task.wait(1)
print("Waited for " .. elapsed .. " seconds")

-- task.cancel: Cancel a scheduled thread
local thread = task.delay(5, function()
    print("This will never run!")
end)
task.cancel(thread)

-- Comparison with deprecated alternatives:
-- task.spawn > coroutine.wrap + spawn
-- task.wait  > wait()
-- task.delay > delay()

output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local kills = 0
    if success and data then
        kills = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "Kills"
    stat.Value = kills
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Kills")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save Kills for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Kills")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function castRay()
    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 200
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    if result then
        print("Hit: " .. result.Instance:GetFullName())
        print("Position: " .. tostring(result.Position))
        print("Normal: " .. tostring(result.Normal))
        print("Distance: " .. tostring(result.Distance))
        return result
    end
    
    return nil
end

instruction: Show me how to What is the difference between WaitForChild and FindFirstChild.
output:
-- FindFirstChild: Immediately checks if a child exists (returns nil if not found)
local part = workspace:FindFirstChild("MyPart")
if part then
    print("Found:", part.Name)
else
    print("Not found")
end

-- FindFirstChild with recursive search
local deepPart = workspace:FindFirstChild("NestedPart", true) -- Searches all descendants

-- WaitForChild: Waits/yields until the child exists (with optional timeout)
local part = workspace:WaitForChild("MyPart")         -- Waits forever
local part = workspace:WaitForChild("MyPart", 5)      -- Waits up to 5 seconds, returns nil on timeout

-- When to use each:
-- Use FindFirstChild when:
--   - The object might not exist and that's okay
--   - You need non-blocking code
--   - You're checking for optional features

-- Use WaitForChild when:
--   - The object will definitely exist but might not have loaded yet
--   - At the start of scripts waiting for the game to load
--   - Loading assets from ReplicatedStorage or ServerStorage

-- Common pattern:
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")  -- Safe, waits for load
local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")  -- May or may not have a tool

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 8)
    end)
end)

instruction: Script for an NPC that wanders randomly within a defined area.
output:
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local WANDER_RADIUS = 30
local HOME_POSITION = rootPart.Position
local WAIT_TIME_MIN = 2
local WAIT_TIME_MAX = 6

local function getRandomPoint()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random() * WANDER_RADIUS
    
    return HOME_POSITION + Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )
end

local function wanderTo(position)
    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
        AgentRadius = 2,
        AgentHeight = 5,
        AgentCanJump = true,
    })
    
    local success = pcall(function()
        path:ComputeAsync(rootPart.Position, position)
    end)
    
    if success and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        for _, waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            humanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            
            local reached = humanoid.MoveToFinished:Wait()
            if not reached then break end
        end
    end
end

-- Wander loop
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
    local target = getRandomPoint()
    wanderTo(target)
    
    local waitTime = math.random(WAIT_TIME_MIN, WAIT_TIME_MAX)
    task.wait(waitTime)
end

instruction: Write a DataStore script to save and load a player's HighScore value.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    local highScore = 0
    if success and data then
        highScore = data
    end
    
    local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
    leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
    leaderstats.Parent = player
    
    local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
    stat.Name = "HighScore"
    stat.Value = highScore
    stat.Parent = leaderstats
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
    local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("HighScore")
    
    if stat then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save HighScore for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
        local stat = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("HighScore")
        if stat then
            pcall(function()
                dataStore:SetAsync(key, stat.Value)
            end)
        end
    end
end)

instruction: Can you write code to Raycast from the mouse position to detect what the player is looking at.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function getMouseRaycast()
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local unitRay = camera:ViewportPointToRay(mouseLocation.X, mouseLocation.Y)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {player.Character}
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(unitRay.Origin, unitRay.Direction * 1000, raycastParams)
    
    return result
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        local result = getMouseRaycast()
        if result then
            print("Clicked on: " .. result.Instance.Name)
        end
    end
end)

    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Create create an object pooling system in Roblox
output:
local Pool = {}
Pool.__index = Pool

function Pool.new(createFn, size)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Pool)
	self._available = {}
	self._inUse = {}
	self._create = createFn
	for i=1,(size or 10) do
		local o = createFn()
		o.Parent = nil
		table.insert(self._available, o)
	end
	return self
end

function Pool:Get()
	local o = table.remove(self._available) or self._create()
	self._inUse[o] = true
	return o
end

function Pool:Return(o)
	if self._inUse[o] then
		self._inUse[o] = nil
		o.Parent = nil
		table.insert(self._available, o)
	end
end

return Pool

instruction: Create a round-based game system with 30s rounds and 10s intermission.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ROUND_TIME = 30
local INTERMISSION = 10

local statusValue = Instance.new("StringValue")
statusValue.Name = "GameStatus"
statusValue.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getAlivePlayers()
    local alive = {}
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            table.insert(alive, player)
        end
    end
    return alive
end

local function startRound()
    statusValue.Value = "Round starting..."
    task.wait(3)
    
    -- Teleport players to arena
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    math.random(-20, 20), 5, math.random(-20, 20)
                )
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Round timer
    for i = ROUND_TIME, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Time: " .. i .. "s"
        
        local alive = getAlivePlayers()
        if #alive <= 1 then
            break
        end
        
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    -- Determine winner
    local alive = getAlivePlayers()
    if #alive == 1 then
        statusValue.Value = alive[1].Name .. " wins!"
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Round over!"
    end
end

-- Main game loop
while true do
    -- Intermission
    for i = INTERMISSION, 0, -1 do
        statusValue.Value = "Intermission: " .. i .. "s"
        task.wait(1)
    end
    
    if #Players:GetPlayers() >= 2 then
        startRound()
    else
        statusValue.Value = "Waiting for players..."
    end
    
    task.wait(5)
end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("CoinsLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Coins")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function giveForceField(player, duration)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    
    local existingFF = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField")
    if existingFF then
        existingFF:Destroy()
    end
    
    local forceField = Instance.new("ForceField")
    forceField.Visible = true
    forceField.Parent = character
    
    task.delay(duration, function()
        if forceField and forceField.Parent then
            forceField:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        giveForceField(player, 13)
    end)
end)

output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("CoinsLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Coins")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Create collision groups
PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup("Players")
PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup("Default")

-- Disable collision between players
PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable("Players", "Players", false)

-- Assign player parts to the group
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CollisionGroup = "Players"
            end
        end
        
        character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
            if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                descendant.CollisionGroup = "Players"
            end
        end)
    end)
end)

    end
    
    return nil
end

instruction: What's the code to a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 150 dealing 30 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 30
local speed = 150
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Show me how to Implement an OOP class pattern in Luau for a game entity.
output:
-- ModuleScript: Entity
local Entity = {}
Entity.__index = Entity

export type EntityData = {
    name: string,
    health: number,
    maxHealth: number,
    damage: number,
    speed: number,
}

function Entity.new(data: EntityData)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Entity)
    self.name = data.name
    self.health = data.health or 100
    self.maxHealth = data.maxHealth or 100
    self.damage = data.damage or 10
    self.speed = data.speed or 16
    self.isAlive = true
    self.effects = {}
    return self
end

function Entity:takeDamage(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    
    self.health = math.max(0, self.health - amount)
    
    if self.health <= 0 then
        self.isAlive = false
        self:onDeath()
    end
end

function Entity:heal(amount: number)
    if not self.isAlive then return end
    self.health = math.min(self.maxHealth, self.health + amount)
end

function Entity:addEffect(effectName: string, duration: number)
    self.effects[effectName] = {
        startTime = os.clock(),
        duration = duration
    }
end

function Entity:hasEffect(effectName: string): boolean
    local effect = self.effects[effectName]
    if not effect then return false end
    
    if os.clock() - effect.startTime > effect.duration then
        self.effects[effectName] = nil
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

function Entity:onDeath()
    print(self.name .. " has been defeated!")
end

function Entity:getHealthPercentage(): number
    return self.health / self.maxHealth
end

return Entity

    debounce = true

    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile

        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()

    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()

        end
    end)

    debounce = false
end)

					if speed > MAX_SPEED then

						if d.Violations >= 3 then p:Kick("Speed exploit") end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function isOnGround(character)
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return false end
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}
    
    local origin = rootPart.Position
    local direction = Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
    
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    return result ~= nil
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local grounded = isOnGround(character)
        -- Use grounded state for game logic
    end)
end)

instruction: Create a global leaderboard using OrderedDataStore for top players by Score.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("ScoreLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Score")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

local status = Instance.new("StringValue")
status.Name = "WaveStatus"
status.Parent = RS
local enemies = {}
local spawns = {Vector3.new(50,5,0),Vector3.new(-50,5,0),Vector3.new(0,5,50),Vector3.new(0,5,-50)}

local function spawn(pos, hp)
	local e = SS:WaitForChild("EnemyTemplate"):Clone()
	e:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(pos))
	e.Parent = workspace
	local h = e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if h then
		h.MaxHealth = hp
		h.Health = hp
		h.Died:Connect(function() task.wait(1) e:Destroy() table.remove(enemies,table.find(enemies,e)) end)
	end
	table.insert(enemies, e)
end

task.spawn(function()
	task.wait(5)
	local wave = 1
	while true do
		local count = 3 + wave*2
		local hp = 50 + wave*25
		status.Value = `Wave {wave} - {count} enemies!`
		task.wait(3)
		for i=1,count do
			spawn(spawns[(i-1)%#spawns+1]+Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),0,math.random(-5,5)), hp)
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
		while #enemies > 0 do
			status.Value = `Wave {wave} - {#enemies} left`
			task.wait(1)
		end
		status.Value = `Wave {wave} Complete!`
		task.wait(5)
		wave += 1
	end
end)

instruction: Code a script that a Axe tool that deals 40 damage when activated.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 40
local debounce = false
local cooldown = 0.5

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    -- Create a hitbox
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local hitbox = Instance.new("Part")
    hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    hitbox.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    hitbox.Anchored = true
    hitbox.CanCollide = false
    hitbox.Transparency = 1
    hitbox.Parent = workspace
    
    local hitPlayers = {}
    
    for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(hitbox)) do
        local targetCharacter = part.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid ~= humanoid and not hitPlayers[targetCharacter] then
            hitPlayers[targetCharacter] = true
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
        end
    end
    
    hitbox:Destroy()
    
    task.wait(cooldown)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Code a script that Demonstrate Luau control flow: if/elseif/else, loops, and conditionals.
output:
-- If/elseif/else
local health = 75
if health > 80 then
    print("Healthy")
elseif health > 40 then
    print("Wounded")
elseif health > 0 then
    print("Critical")
else
    print("Dead")
end

-- Ternary-like pattern (Luau)
local status = if health > 50 then "Alive" else "Dying"

-- For loop (numeric)
for i = 1, 10 do
    print(i)
end

-- For loop with step
for i = 10, 1, -1 do
    print(i) -- Countdown
end

-- While loop
local count = 0
while count < 5 do
    count = count + 1
    print(count)
end

-- Repeat/until
repeat
    count = count - 1
until count <= 0

-- Continue (Luau feature)
for i = 1, 10 do
    if i % 2 == 0 then
        continue -- Skip even numbers
    end
    print(i) -- Only odd numbers
end

-- Break
for i = 1, 100 do
    if i > 10 then
        break
    end
    print(i)
end

instruction: What's the code to a DataStore system that saves a full player profile table with multiple stats and inventory.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerProfiles")

local DEFAULT_DATA = {
    coins = 0,
    gems = 0,
    level = 1,
    experience = 0,
    inventory = {},
    settings = {
        musicEnabled = true,
        sfxEnabled = true,
    },
    stats = {
        wins = 0,
        losses = 0,
        totalPlayTime = 0,
    }
}

local playerData = {}

local function deepCopy(original)
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(original) do
        if typeof(value) == "table" then
            copy[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            copy[key] = value
        end
    end
    return copy
end

local function loadData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local success, data = pcall(function()
        return dataStore:GetAsync(key)
    end)
    
    if success and data then
        playerData[player.UserId] = data
    else
        playerData[player.UserId] = deepCopy(DEFAULT_DATA)
    end
    
    return playerData[player.UserId]
end

local function saveData(player)
    local key = "Profile_" .. player.UserId
    local data = playerData[player.UserId]
    
    if data then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            dataStore:SetAsync(key, data)
        end)
        
        if not success then
            warn("Failed to save data for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. err)
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    loadData(player)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    saveData(player)
    playerData[player.UserId] = nil
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        saveData(player)
    end
end)

instruction: Create a projectile weapon that fires a ball at speed 200 dealing 10 damage on hit.
output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 10
local speed = 200
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)

instruction: Show me how to use task.spawn, task.defer, and task.delay.
output:
-- task.spawn: Runs a function immediately in a new thread
task.spawn(function()
    print("This runs immediately in a new thread")
    task.wait(5)
    print("This runs after 5 seconds")
end)
print("This also runs immediately, doesn't wait for spawn")

-- task.defer: Runs a function at the end of the current resumption cycle
task.defer(function()
    print("This runs after the current thread yields")
end)
print("This runs first")

-- task.delay: Runs a function after a specified delay
task.delay(3, function()
    print("This runs after 3 seconds")
end)
print("This runs immediately")

-- task.wait: Yields the current thread for a duration (returns actual elapsed time)
local elapsed = task.wait(1)
print("Waited for " .. elapsed .. " seconds")

-- task.cancel: Cancel a scheduled thread
local thread = task.delay(5, function()
    print("This will never run!")
end)
task.cancel(thread)

-- Comparison with deprecated alternatives:
-- task.spawn > coroutine.wrap + spawn
-- task.wait  > wait()
-- task.delay > delay()

instruction: Script for Show different debounce patterns used in Roblox development.
output:
-- Simple boolean debounce
local debounce = false

local function onTouch(hit)
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    -- Do something
    print("Touched!")
    
    task.wait(1)
    debounce = false
end

-- Per-player debounce
local playerDebounce = {}

local function onPlayerTouch(player)
    if playerDebounce[player.UserId] then return end
    playerDebounce[player.UserId] = true
    
    print(player.Name .. " activated!")
    
    task.delay(2, function()
        playerDebounce[player.UserId] = nil
    end)
end

-- Throttle pattern (limit calls per time window)
local function throttle(func, interval)
    local lastCall = 0
    return function(...)
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastCall >= interval then
            lastCall = now
            return func(...)
        end
    end
end

local throttledPrint = throttle(function(msg)
    print(msg)
end, 1)

-- Cooldown with visual feedback
local function createCooldown(duration)
    local isReady = true
    local remaining = 0
    
    return {
        use = function()
            if not isReady then return false end
            isReady = false
            remaining = duration
            
            task.spawn(function()
                while remaining > 0 do
                    remaining = remaining - task.wait()
                end
                remaining = 0
                isReady = true
            end)
            
            return true
        end,
        isReady = function() return isReady end,
        getRemaining = function() return remaining end
    }
end

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.DisplayOrder = 10
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local container = Instance.new("Frame")
container.Size = UDim2.new(0.3,0,1,0)
container.Position = UDim2.new(0.7,-10,0,10)
container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
container.Parent = gui
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,5)
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
layout.Parent = container

local function notify(title, msg, dur)
	dur = dur or 4
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,60)
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.Parent = container
	Instance.new("UICorner",f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)
	local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	t.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,1,0)
	t.Position = UDim2.new(0,5,0,0)
	t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	t.Text = title..": "..msg
	t.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
	t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	t.TextScaled = true
	t.TextTransparency = 1
	t.Parent = f
	local fadeIn = TweenInfo.new(0.3)
	TweenService:Create(f,fadeIn,{BackgroundTransparency=0.1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(t,fadeIn,{TextTransparency=0}):Play()
	task.delay(dur, function()
		local fadeOut = TweenInfo.new(0.5)
		TweenService:Create(f,fadeOut,{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
		local tw = TweenService:Create(t,fadeOut,{TextTransparency=1})
		tw:Play()
		tw.Completed:Wait()
		f:Destroy()
	end)
end

return notify

instruction: Create a Luau script that will a map voting system where players can vote for one of three maps.
output:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local maps = {"Desert", "Forest", "City"}
local votes = {}
local playerVotes = {}

local voteEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
voteEvent.Name = "VoteEvent"
voteEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function resetVotes()
    votes = {}
    for _, mapName in ipairs(maps) do
        votes[mapName] = 0
    end
    playerVotes = {}
end

local function getWinningMap()
    local maxVotes = 0
    local winner = maps[1]
    
    for mapName, count in pairs(votes) do
        if count > maxVotes then
            maxVotes = count
            winner = mapName
        end
    end
    
    return winner
end

voteEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, mapChoice)
    if not table.find(maps, mapChoice) then return end
    
    -- Remove previous vote
    if playerVotes[player.UserId] then
        votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] = votes[playerVotes[player.UserId]] - 1
    end
    
    -- Add new vote
    playerVotes[player.UserId] = mapChoice
    votes[mapChoice] = votes[mapChoice] + 1
    
    -- Broadcast updated votes
    voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)
end)

-- Start voting
resetVotes()
voteEvent:FireAllClients(votes)

task.wait(20) -- Voting period
local winningMap = getWinningMap()
print("Winning map: " .. winningMap)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local GAMEPASS_ID = 0 -- Replace with your GamePass ID

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    local success, ownsPass = pcall(function()
        return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, GAMEPASS_ID)
    end)
    
    if success and ownsPass then
        print(player.Name .. " owns the GamePass!")
        
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
            local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 24  -- Speed bonus
            humanoid.JumpPower = 75  -- Jump bonus
        end)
    end
end)

instruction: What's the code to a global leaderboard using OrderedDataStore for top players by Wins.
output:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local orderedStore = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("WinsLeaderboard")

local function getTopPlayers(count)
    local success, pages = pcall(function()
        return orderedStore:GetSortedAsync(false, count)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to fetch leaderboard")
        return {}
    end
    
    local entries = {}
    local data = pages:GetCurrentPage()
    
    for rank, entry in ipairs(data) do
        table.insert(entries, {
            rank = rank,
            userId = entry.key,
            value = entry.value
        })
    end
    
    return entries
end

local function updateLeaderboard(userId, value)
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        orderedStore:SetAsync(tostring(userId), value)
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("Failed to update leaderboard: " .. err)
    end
end

-- Refresh leaderboard every 60 seconds
while true do
    local topPlayers = getTopPlayers(10)
    for _, entry in ipairs(topPlayers) do
        print("#" .. entry.rank .. " - User " .. entry.userId .. ": " .. entry.value .. " Wins")
    end
    task.wait(60)
end

local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local spawnFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("SpawnPoints")
local enemyTemplate = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("Enemy")

local MAX_ENEMIES = 10
local SPAWN_INTERVAL = 5
local activeEnemies = {}

local function getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local spawns = spawnFolder:GetChildren()
    return spawns[math.random(1, #spawns)]
end

local function spawnEnemy()
    if #activeEnemies >= MAX_ENEMIES then return end
    
    local spawnPoint = getRandomSpawnPoint()
    local enemy = enemyTemplate:Clone()
    enemy:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(spawnPoint.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
    enemy.Parent = workspace
    
    table.insert(activeEnemies, enemy)
    
    local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(2)
            local index = table.find(activeEnemies, enemy)
            if index then
                table.remove(activeEnemies, index)
            end
            enemy:Destroy()
        end)
    end
end

-- Spawn loop
while true do
    spawnEnemy()
    task.wait(SPAWN_INTERVAL)
end

output:
local tool = script.Parent
local damage = 50
local speed = 50
local debounce = false

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true
    
    local character = tool.Parent
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not rootPart then
        debounce = false
        return
    end
    
    local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
    projectile.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    projectile.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    projectile.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
    projectile.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    projectile.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
    projectile.CanCollide = false
    projectile.Parent = workspace
    
    local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    velocity.Velocity = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * speed
    velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    velocity.Parent = projectile
    
    projectile.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local targetChar = hit.Parent
        local targetHumanoid = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        if targetHumanoid and targetChar ~= character then
            targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.delay(5, function()
        if projectile and projectile.Parent then
            projectile:Destroy()
        end
    end)
    
    task.wait(0.3)
    debounce = false
end)
